title.zh: 卷345 列傳一百三十二 永保 惠龄 宜绵子 瑚素通阿 英善 福寧 景安 秦承恩
title.en: Volume 345 Biographies 132: Yong Bao, Hui Ling, Yi Mian Zi, Hu Su Tong A, Ying Shan, Fu Ning, Jing An, Qin Chengen
title.raw: 卷345 列傳一百三十二 永保 惠龄 宜绵子 瑚素通阿 英善 福寧 景安 秦承恩

sentences.zh: 永保，費莫氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，勒保之弟也。

translations.literal: Yong Bao, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and the younger brother of Le Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered Red Banner and the younger brother of Le Bao.

sentences.zh: 以官學生考授內閣中書，充軍機章京，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: As a student of the Imperial Academy he passed examination for appointment as a secretary of the Grand Secretariat, served as a clerk of the Grand Council, and was promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the examination as an Imperial Academy student, he was appointed a secretary of the Grand Secretariat, served as a clerk of the Grand Council, and was promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，父溫福徵金川，永保齎送定邊將軍印，遂隨軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong, his father Wen Fu campaigned against Jinchuan; Yong Bao carried the seal of the Pacification Commissioner and then followed the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, his father Wen Fu marched against Jinchuan; Yong Bao delivered the seal of the frontier pacification commissioner and then accompanied the army.

sentences.zh: 明年，溫福戰歿木果木，永保冒矢石奪回父屍，襲輕車都尉，遷吏部郎中。

translations.literal: The next year Wen Fu died in battle at Mugua Wood; Yong Bao braved arrows and stones to recover his father's body, inherited the rank of Commandant of Light Chariots, and was transferred to director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Wen Fu was killed in battle at Mugua Wood; Yong Bao braved enemy fire to recover his father's body, inherited the rank of Commandant of Light Chariots, and was appointed a director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 洎金川平，追論木果木之敗，咎在溫福，奪世職，仍留永保原官。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, the defeat at Mugua Wood was reviewed; blame was placed on Wen Fu, his hereditary office was stripped, but Yong Bao was allowed to keep his original post.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified, the defeat at Mugua Wood was reviewed retrospectively; Wen Fu was held responsible and his hereditary rank was revoked, but Yong Bao was permitted to retain his original office.

sentences.zh: 出為直隸口北道，歷霸昌、清河兩道。

translations.literal: He went out as intendant of the Koubei Circuit in Zhili and successively held the Bachang and Qinghe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as intendant of the Koubei Circuit in Zhili and later served in the Bachang and Qinghe circuits in succession.

sentences.zh: 遷布政使，調江蘇。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial treasurer and then to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to provincial treasurer and transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，擢貴州巡撫，歷江西、陝西。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he was promoted to governor of Guizhou and successively served in Jiangxi and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he was promoted to governor of Guizhou and later held the same post in Jiangxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he acted as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year he served as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 尋授塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Grand Minister Consultant at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Grand Minister Consultant at Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，哈薩克汗斡裡素勒坦遣子入覲，詔嘉永保撫綏有方，授內大臣，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year the Kazakh khan Walisultan sent his son to court; an edict praised Yong Bao's effective pacification, appointed him a Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, and bestowed double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year the Kazakh khan Walisultan sent his son to pay homage at court; the throne praised Yong Bao's skillful pacification, appointed him a Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, and awarded him double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣，授戶部侍郎，留駐新疆。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he was transferred to Grand Minister Consultant at Kashgar, appointed vice-president of the Board of Revenue, and remained stationed in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year he was transferred to Grand Minister Consultant at Kashgar, appointed vice-president of the Board of Revenue, and remained on duty in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 六十年，調烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was transferred to military governor of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was transferred to military governor of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年春，湖北教匪起，永保奉詔入京，行抵西安，命偕將軍恆瑞率駐防兵二千，調陝西、廣西、山東兵五千會剿。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Jiaqing sect rebels rose in Hubei; Yong Bao received orders to enter the capital, reached Xi'an en route, and was commanded with General Hengrui to lead two thousand garrison troops and mobilize five thousand from Shaanxi, Guangxi, and Shandong for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Jiaqing, sect rebels broke out in Hubei; Yong Bao was ordered to proceed to the capital, and when he reached Xi'an he was instructed to join General Hengrui in leading two thousand garrison troops and assembling five thousand men from Shaanxi, Guangxi, and Shandong for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 三月，至湖北，總督畢沅疏陳各路剿殺不下數万，而賊起益熾。

translations.literal: In the third month he reached Hubei; Governor-General Bi Yuan memorialized that the various routes had killed no fewer than tens of thousands, yet the rebels grew fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he arrived in Hubei; Governor-General Bi Yuan reported that the various columns had killed tens of thousands of rebels, yet the uprising only grew fiercer.

sentences.zh: 詔分專責成：永保、恆瑞任竹山、保康一路；

translations.literal: An edict divided exclusive responsibility: Yong Bao and Hengrui were charged with the Zhushan and Baokang route;
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned separate areas of responsibility: Yong Bao and Hengrui were to handle the Zhushan and Baokang route;

sentences.zh: 畢沅、舒亮任當陽、遠安、東湖一路；

translations.literal: Bi Yuan and Shuliang with the Dangyang, Yuan'an, and Donghu route;
translations.idiomatic: Bi Yuan and Shuliang with the Dangyang, Yuan'an, and Donghu route;

sentences.zh: 惠齡、富志那任枝江一路；

translations.literal: Huiling and Fuzhina with the Zhijiang route;
translations.idiomatic: Huiling and Fuzhina with the Zhijiang route;

sentences.zh: 鄂輝任襄陽、穀城、均州、光化一路；

translations.literal: E Hui with the Xiangyang, Gucheng, Junzhou, and Guanghua route;
translations.idiomatic: E Hui with the Xiangyang, Gucheng, Junzhou, and Guanghua route;

sentences.zh: 孫士毅任酉陽、來鳳一路。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi with the Youyang and Laifeng route.
translations.idiomatic: and Sun Shiyi with the Youyang and Laifeng route.

sentences.zh: 永保偕恆瑞复竹山，進房縣，擒賊首祁中耀；

translations.literal: Yong Bao with Hengrui recovered Zhushan, advanced into Fang County, and captured the rebel leader Qi Zhongyao;
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao and Hengrui recaptured Zhushan, advanced into Fang County, and captured the rebel leader Qi Zhongyao;

sentences.zh: 餘賊遁保康白雲寺山，复敗之，擒賊目曾世興等。

translations.literal: the remaining rebels fled to Baiyun Temple Mountain in Baokang; they were again defeated and rebel officers including Zeng Shixing were captured.
translations.idiomatic: the remaining rebels fled to Baiyun Temple Mountain in Baokang; they were defeated again, and rebel officers including Zeng Shixing were taken.

sentences.zh: 永保疏言：「襄陽賊數万，最猖獗，賊首姚之富、齊王氏、劉之協皆在其中，為四方諸賊領袖，破之則流賊自瓦解。

translations.literal: Yong Bao memorialized: "The rebels at Xiangyang number tens of thousands and are the most violent; the chiefs Yao Zhifu, Qi Wangshi, and Liu Zhixie are all among them and are leaders of rebels everywhere—if they are broken the roving bandits will collapse of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao memorialized: "The rebels at Xiangyang number in the tens of thousands and are the most formidable; the chieftains Yao Zhifu, Qi Wangshi, and Liu Zhixie are all there and serve as leaders for rebels throughout the region. If that force is broken, the roving bands will collapse on their own.

sentences.zh: 宜俟諸軍大集，合力分攻。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to wait until the armies are fully assembled and then attack in concert from several directions."
translations.idiomatic: We should wait until the armies have fully assembled and then strike together from several directions."

sentences.zh: 帝韙之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 五月，永保等馳赴襄陽，自樊城進取鄧桃湖，會軍呂堰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yong Bao and others hurried to Xiangyang, advanced from Fancheng to take Dengtao Lake, and joined forces at Lüyan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yong Bao and his colleagues hurried to Xiangyang, advanced from Fancheng against Dengtao Lake, and joined the main force at Lüyan.

sentences.zh: 賊退屯雙溝，分軍五路夾擊，殲賊二千餘，賊分竄孝感，距漢陽百餘裡，幸為潦阻，武昌戒嚴。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew to Shuanggou; the army divided into five columns for a pincer attack and destroyed more than two thousand rebels; the rebels scattered toward Xiaogan, within a hundred-odd li of Hankou, but fortunately were blocked by floodwaters, and Wuchang was placed under alert.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back to Shuanggou; the army split into five columns for a converging attack and killed more than two thousand rebels. Part of the rebel force scattered toward Xiaogan, barely a hundred li from Hankou; only floodwaters blocked them, and Wuchang was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 時畢沅圍當陽數​​月不下，惠齡剿枝江賊亦無功，詔命永保總統湖北諸軍，先靖襄陽，而後分攻孝感、當陽兩路。

translations.literal: At this time Bi Yuan had besieged Dangyang for months without success, and Huiling's suppression of the Zhijiang rebels had also failed; an edict appointed Yong Bao commander-in-chief of all Hubei forces, first to pacify Xiangyang and then to attack separately along the Xiaogan and Dangyang routes.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Yuan had by then besieged Dangyang for months without success, and Huiling's campaign against the Zhijiang rebels had also failed. Yong Bao was ordered to take overall command of the Hubei armies, pacify Xiangyang first, and then divide his forces between the Xiaogan and Dangyang routes.

sentences.zh: 參將傅成明等擊孝感賊，遇伏敗歿；

translations.literal: Major Fu Chengming and others attacked the Xiaogan rebels, met an ambush, and were killed;
translations.idiomatic: Major Fu Chengming and others attacked the Xiaogan rebels, were ambushed, and killed in defeat;

sentences.zh: 永保令明亮馳救，復請調苗疆防兵助剿。

translations.literal: Yong Bao ordered Mingliang to hurry to the rescue and again requested transfer of Miao frontier garrison troops to assist suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao ordered Mingliang to hurry to their relief and again requested that Miao frontier garrison troops be transferred to assist the campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，永保渡滾河，破梁家岡、張家垱賊營二十餘座，賊竄棗陽，潛踞隨州之梓山、青潭，連破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yong Bao crossed the Gun River, destroyed more than twenty rebel camps at Liangjiagang and Zhangjia'ang, the rebels fled to Zaoyang and secretly occupied Zishan and Qingtan in Suizhou, and he defeated them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yong Bao crossed the Gun River and destroyed more than twenty rebel camps at Liangjiagang and Zhangjia'ang. The rebels fled to Zaoyang and secretly occupied Zishan and Qingtan in Suizhou; he defeated them in succession.

sentences.zh: 复偕恆瑞、慶成破賊於紅土山，擒賊渠黃玉貴。

translations.literal: Again with Hengrui and Qingcheng he defeated the rebels at Hongtu Mountain and captured the rebel chieftain Huang Yugui.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Hengrui and Qingcheng to defeat the rebels at Hongtu Mountain and capture the rebel chieftain Huang Yugui.

sentences.zh: 於是襄陽、呂堰迤東百數十里，及棗陽、隨州、宜城無賊氛。

translations.literal: Thereupon for a hundred-odd li east of Xiangyang and Lüyan, and in Zaoyang, Suizhou, and Yicheng, no rebel presence remained.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter for more than a hundred li east of Xiangyang and Lüyan, and throughout Zaoyang, Suizhou, and Yicheng, the region was cleared of rebels.

sentences.zh: 孝感之賊​​，亦為明亮所殲。

translations.literal: The rebels at Xiaogan were also destroyed by Mingliang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels at Xiaogan were also wiped out by Mingliang.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉永保調度協宜，加太子太保。

translations.literal: An edict praised Yong Bao's well-coordinated command and added the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Yong Bao's effective coordination and promoted him to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 先是命署湖廣總督，及畢沅復當陽，永保請寢前命，允之。

translations.literal: Earlier he had been ordered to act as governor-general of Huguang; when Bi Yuan recovered Dangyang, Yong Bao requested withdrawal of the earlier order, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He had earlier been ordered to serve as acting governor-general of Huguang; when Bi Yuan recovered Dangyang, Yong Bao asked that the earlier appointment be withdrawn, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 八月，移剿鍾祥，明亮以師來會。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he shifted suppression to Zhongxiang; Mingliang came with troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he shifted the campaign to Zhongxiang, and Mingliang brought his troops to join him.

sentences.zh: 賊自溫浹口至千弓垱，依山結營，亙數十里。

translations.literal: From Wenjiakou to Qiangong'ang the rebels had built camps along the hills stretching for dozens of li.
translations.idiomatic: From Wenjiakou to Qiangong'ang the rebels had built camps along the hills for dozens of li.

sentences.zh: 永保率大軍由西北進擊，繪圖陳奏。

translations.literal: Yong Bao led the main force in an attack from the northwest and submitted a map with his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao led the main army in an attack from the northwest and submitted a map with his report.

sentences.zh: 帝方以東南空虛，慮賊逃竄，適明亮疏言：「鍾祥為賊巢穴，宜四面夾攻，以防漏網。

translations.literal: The emperor was just then concerned that the southeast was empty and the rebels might escape, when Mingliang memorialized: "Zhongxiang is the rebels' lair; it should be attacked from four sides to prevent any slipping through the net.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was already worried that the southeast was undefended and the rebels might escape, when Mingliang memorialized: "Zhongxiang is the rebels' stronghold and should be attacked from four sides to keep any from slipping through the net.

sentences.zh: 今永保以九千餘兵由西北追壓，而東南要截之兵僅三千餘，地闊兵單，難杜竄逸。」

translations.literal: Now Yong Bao presses from the northwest with more than nine thousand troops, while the intercepting force in the southeast has only a little over three thousand; the ground is broad and the troops few, making it hard to block escape."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yong Bao is pressing from the northwest with more than nine thousand men, while the intercepting force in the southeast has only a little over three thousand. The ground is wide and the troops too few to block escape."

sentences.zh: 帝以永保擁眾自衛，切責之。

translations.literal: The emperor regarded Yong Bao as hoarding troops for self-protection and sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor concluded that Yong Bao was keeping his troops for self-protection and rebuked him sharply.

sentences.zh: 明亮敗賊土門衝，永保不能夾擊，賊轉而北，永保偕明亮追至襄陽雙溝。

translations.literal: Mingliang defeated the rebels at Tumenchong, but Yong Bao could not strike in concert; the rebels turned north, and Yong Bao with Mingliang pursued them to Shuanggou in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang defeated the rebels at Tumenchong, but Yong Bao failed to attack in concert; the rebels turned north, and Yong Bao and Mingliang pursued them to Shuanggou in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 賊分兩路竄河南：東由棗陽趨唐縣，西由呂堰趨鄧州。

translations.literal: The rebels split into two columns and fled into Henan: the eastern route from Zaoyang toward Tang County, the western from Lüyan toward Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels split into two columns and fled into Henan: one east from Zaoyang toward Tang County, the other west from Lüyan toward Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 官軍躡西路，敗諸呂堰，獲姚之富母、媳及孫，而東路賊已入唐縣滹沱鎮。

translations.literal: The government army followed the western route, defeated them at Lüyan, and captured Yao Zhifu's mother, daughter-in-law, and grandson; but the eastern rebels had already entered Hutuo Town in Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: The government forces followed the western column, defeated them at Lüyan, and captured Yao Zhifu's mother, daughter-in-law, and grandson; but the eastern rebels had already entered Hutuo Town in Tang County.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「追賊經月，兵力疲憊，難以痛殲，請增兵助剿。」

translations.literal: A memorial stated: "We have pursued the rebels for a month; the troops are exhausted and it is hard to destroy them decisively—please add troops to assist suppression."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "We have pursued the rebels for a month; the troops are exhausted and a decisive victory is impossible. I request reinforcements for the campaign."

sentences.zh: 詔斥其無能，調山東、直隸兵四千，复簡健銳、火器營各軍赴之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked his incompetence, transferred four thousand troops from Shandong and Zhili, and again selected detachments from the Elite and Firearms camps to go.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked his incompetence, transferred four thousand troops from Shandong and Zhili, and again detached units from the Elite and Firearms camps to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，新兵既至，攻破唐縣賊屯十一。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, once the new troops arrived, eleven rebel camps in Tang County were stormed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, after the new troops arrived, eleven rebel camps in Tang County were stormed.

sentences.zh: 姚之富已遁，犯棗陽，复渡滾河而西，蹂呂堰，向光化、穀城。

translations.literal: Yao Zhifu had already escaped, struck Zaoyang, again crossed the Gun River westward, ravaged Lüyan, and moved toward Guanghua and Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zhifu had already escaped, raided Zaoyang, crossed the Gun River again to the west, ravaged Lüyan, and advanced toward Guanghua and Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 圍景安於鄧州魏家集，越二日，援兵始至。

translations.literal: They besieged Jing'an at Weijiaji in Dengzhou; only after two days did relief arrive.
translations.idiomatic: They besieged Jing'an at Weijiaji in Dengzhou; relief did not arrive until two days later.

sentences.zh: 帝怒永保擁勁旅萬餘，徒尾追不迎擊，致賊東西橫躪無忌，褫職逮京，下獄，籍其家，並褫其子侍衛寧志、寧怡職，發往熱河。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged that Yong Bao held more than ten thousand crack troops yet only trailed in pursuit without intercepting, allowing the rebels to ravage east and west at will; his office was stripped, he was arrested and brought to the capital, imprisoned, and his property confiscated; his sons the bodyguards Ningzhi and Ningyi were also dismissed and sent to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged that Yong Bao commanded more than ten thousand crack troops yet only trailed the rebels without intercepting them, allowing them to ravage the region at will. He was stripped of office, arrested and brought to the capital, imprisoned, and his property confiscated; his sons, the imperial bodyguards Ningzhi and Ningyi, were also dismissed and sent to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 三年，以兄勒保擒川賊王三槐功，推恩宥釋。

translations.literal: In the third year, through his elder brother Le Bao's merit in capturing the Sichuan rebel Wang Sanhuai, clemency was extended and he was released.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, through his elder brother Le Bao's success in capturing the Sichuan rebel Wang Sanhuai, he was pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 勒保請將永保發軍營效力，不許。

translations.literal: Le Bao requested that Yong Bao be sent to serve in the army; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao asked that Yong Bao be sent to serve at the front, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 四年，勒保為經略大臣，予永保藍翎侍衛，齎經略印赴軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Le Bao became commissioner-general; Yong Bao was made a blue-laced bodyguard and sent to the army bearing the commissioner-general's seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Le Bao was appointed commissioner-general; Yong Bao was made a blue-laced bodyguard and sent to the army with the commissioner-general's seal.

sentences.zh: 尋擢頭等侍衛，署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to first-class bodyguard and acted as governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to first-class bodyguard and appointed acting governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 與明亮會剿張漢潮於終南華林山中，遇伏敗績；

translations.literal: With Mingliang he jointly suppressed Zhang Hanchao in the Hualin Mountains of the Zhongnan range and met an ambush in defeat;
translations.idiomatic: He joined Mingliang in suppressing Zhang Hanchao in the Hualin Mountains of the Zhongnan range, but they were ambushed and defeated;

sentences.zh: 復與明亮不協，互攻訐。

translations.literal: again he was at odds with Mingliang and they exchanged accusations.
translations.idiomatic: he again fell out with Mingliang, and the two exchanged accusations.

sentences.zh: 詔逮問，並坐前在湖北動用軍需受饋遺事，論大辟，詔原之，免罪，予八品領催，自備資斧赴烏里雅蘇台辦事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his arrest and interrogation; he was also convicted for earlier misuse of military supplies and acceptance of gifts in Hubei, sentenced to death, then pardoned by edict, exempted from punishment, given an eighth-rank company command, and at his own expense sent to Uliastai on duty.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his arrest and trial; he was also convicted for earlier misuse of military supplies and acceptance of gifts in Hubei and sentenced to death, but was then pardoned, reduced to an eighth-rank company command, and sent at his own expense to serve at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 六年，充參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he served as Grand Minister Consultant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he served as Grand Minister Consultant.

sentences.zh: 七年，授雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 八年，威遠、思茅倮匪擾邊，永保赴普洱，偕提督烏大經進討。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Lolo bandits at Weiyuan and Simao disturbed the border; Yong Bao went to Pu'er and with Provincial Military Commissioner Wudajing advanced to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Lolo bandits at Weiyuan and Simao raided the frontier; Yong Bao went to Pu'er and advanced with Provincial Military Commissioner Wudajing to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 肇亂土弁刁永和聞風遁，威遠倮匪亦退，擒思茅倮酋扎安波賽悶，餘匪奔逸。

translations.literal: The native officer Diao Yonghe, who had started the trouble, fled at the news; the Weiyuan Lolo bandits also withdrew; the Simao Lolo chief Zha'anbo Saikun was captured and the remaining bandits scattered.
translations.idiomatic: The native officer Diao Yonghe, who had started the unrest, fled at the news; the Weiyuan Lolo bandits also withdrew; the Simao Lolo chief Zha'anbo Saikun was captured, and the remaining bandits scattered.

sentences.zh: 南興土司張輔國屢與孟連土司爭界構釁，至是勘定之。

translations.literal: The Nanxing tusi Zhang Fuguo had repeatedly clashed with the Menglian tusi over borders; now the boundaries were surveyed and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanxing chieftain Zhang Fuguo had repeatedly clashed with the Menglian chieftain over their border; the boundary was now surveyed and fixed.

sentences.zh: 永保疏陳善後事：「內地雜居夷人不法，按律懲治；

translations.literal: Yong Bao memorialized on postwar arrangements: "When non-Han living mixed in the interior break the law, punish according to statute;
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao memorialized on postwar arrangements: "When non-Han peoples living among the settled population break the law, they should be punished according to statute;

sentences.zh: 土司夷境滋事，但遣兵防範，不使內竄。」

translations.literal: when trouble arises in tusi or tribal territory, only send troops to guard and prevent incursion into the interior."
translations.idiomatic: when trouble arises in chieftain or tribal territory, troops should be sent only to guard the frontier and prevent raids into the interior."

sentences.zh: 詔嘉得大體，弭邊釁，賞花翎。

translations.literal: An edict praised his grasp of essentials, the border quarrel was settled, and peacock feathers were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised his sound grasp of policy, the border conflict was settled, and he was awarded peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 十三年，兼署貴州巡撫，調廣東。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he also acted as governor of Guizhou and was transferred to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he also served as acting governor of Guizhou and was transferred to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 尋擢兩廣總督，未至，卒於途。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to governor-general of Liangguang but died on the road before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to governor-general of the Two Guangs but died on the journey before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 贈內大臣，詔念前勞，曾籍沒，家無餘貲，賜銀千兩治喪，諡恪敏。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made a Grand Minister of the Imperial Household; an edict recalled his earlier service, noted that his property had once been confiscated and the family had no surplus wealth, granted a thousand taels of silver for the funeral, and gave the posthumous title Kemin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made a Grand Minister of the Imperial Household; an edict recalled his earlier service, noted that his property had once been confiscated and his family left with nothing, granted a thousand taels of silver for the funeral, and gave him the posthumous title Kemin.

sentences.zh: 孫文慶，咸豐中官大學士，自有傳。

translations.literal: His grandson Wen Qing became a Grand Secretary in the Xianfeng reign and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Wen Qing became a Grand Secretary under the Xianfeng emperor and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 惠齡，字椿亭，薩爾圖克氏，蒙古正白旗人。

translations.literal: Huiling, style Chunting, of the Sartuk clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling, style name Chunting, of the Sartuk clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父納延泰，乾隆中，官理籓院尚書、軍機大臣，加太子少保。

translations.literal: His father Nayantai, in the Qianlong reign, served as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Grand Councillor, with the added title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: His father Nayantai served during the Qianlong reign as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and as a Grand Councillor, with the added title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 因喀爾喀台吉沁多爾濟規避軍事，不劾奏，罷職。

translations.literal: Because the Khalkha taiji Jindorji evaded military service and he failed to memorialize impeachment, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for failing to memorialize the impeachment of the Khalkha taiji Jindorji, who had evaded military service.

sentences.zh: 復起用，終於理籓院侍郎。

translations.literal: He was later reappointed and ended his career as vice-minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was later reappointed and ended his career as vice-minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 惠齡由繙譯官補戶部筆帖式，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: Huiling entered service from the translation corps as a clerk in the Board of Revenue and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling entered service from the translation corps as a clerk in the Board of Revenue and served as a clerk of the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷員外郎，緣事奪職。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director but lost his post on account of an incident.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to vice director but lost his post because of an incident.

sentences.zh: 起戶部主事，仍直軍機。

translations.literal: He was reappointed as a director in the Board of Revenue and continued on duty at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was reappointed as a director in the Board of Revenue and continued to serve at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十年，予副都統銜，充西寧辦事大臣，調伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year of Qianlong he was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief, served as commissioner at Xining, and was transferred to brigade commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year of the Qianlong reign he was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief, served as commissioner at Xining, and was transferred to brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 擢工部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice-president of the Board of Works and transferred to the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice-president of the Board of Works and transferred to the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 充塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Minister Consultant at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Grand Minister Consultant at Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 五十年，回京，署正黃旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he returned to the capital and acted as vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he returned to the capital and served as acting vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 授湖北巡撫，調山東。

translations.literal: He was appointed governor of Hubei and transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Hubei and transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，擢四川總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was promoted to governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he was promoted to governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 徵廓爾喀，命為參贊，赴西藏會剿，督治糧運。

translations.literal: During the Gurkha campaign he was ordered as commissioner to Tibet for joint suppression and supervised grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Nepal he was appointed commissioner, sent to Tibet for the joint campaign, and placed in charge of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 事平，圖形紫光閣，列前十五功臣中。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifteen meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifteen meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，授山東巡撫，調湖北，再調安徽。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he was appointed governor of Shandong, transferred to Hubei, and again to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year he was appointed governor of Shandong, then transferred to Hubei and again to Anhui.

sentences.zh: 六十年，授戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was appointed vice-president of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was appointed vice-president of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 苗疆用兵，留署湖北巡撫，治糧餉。

translations.literal: When troops were used in the Miao frontier he remained to act as governor of Hubei and managed provisions.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao frontier campaign began, he remained as acting governor of Hubei in charge of provisions.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年正月，教匪聶傑人、張正謨等倡亂於枝江、宜都，率師往剿，總兵富志那擒首逆聶傑人，而襄、鄖、宜、施諸郡賊並起。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jiaqing the sect rebels Nie Jieren, Zhang Zhenmo, and others raised rebellion at Zhijiang and Yidu; he led troops to suppress them and Major Fuzhina captured the chief rebel Nie Jieren, but rebels rose together in the prefectures of Xiang, Yun, Yi, and Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Jiaqing, the sect rebels Nie Jieren, Zhang Zhenmo, and others rose at Zhijiang and Yidu; he led troops to suppress them, and Major Fuzhina captured the chief rebel Nie Jieren, but uprisings broke out simultaneously across the Xiang, Yun, Yi, and Shi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 命惠齡專剿枝江、宜都一路，自春徂夏無功，以大雨為解，嚴詔切責。

translations.literal: Huiling was ordered to specialize in suppressing the Zhijiang and Yidu route; from spring to summer he achieved nothing and pleaded heavy rain as excuse, and a stern edict sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling was ordered to concentrate on the Zhijiang and Yidu route; from spring through summer he achieved nothing and blamed the heavy rains, drawing a stern imperial rebuke.

sentences.zh: 八月，克灌腦灣賊寨，擒張正謨等，加太子少保，署工部尚書，予二等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he stormed the rebel stockade at Guannaowan and captured Zhang Zhenmo and others; he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, acted as minister of the Board of Works, and granted a hereditary second-rank commandancy of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he stormed the rebel stockade at Guannaowan and captured Zhang Zhenmo and others; he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed acting minister of the Board of Works, and granted a hereditary second-rank commandancy of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 進攻涼山，搗其巢，擒首逆覃士潮，宜都、枝江悉平，移軍長陽黃柏山會剿。

translations.literal: He advanced against Liangshan, destroyed their lair, and captured the chief rebel Tan Shichao; Yidu and Zhijiang were entirely pacified, and he moved his army to Huangbai Mountain in Changyang for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Liangshan, destroyed the rebels' stronghold, and captured the chief rebel Tan Shichao; Yidu and Zhijiang were fully pacified, and he moved his army to Huangbai Mountain in Changyang for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 十一月，襄陽賊姚之富自黃龍垱偷渡滾河，竄河南，黜總統永保，以惠齡代之，馳赴襄陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Xiangyang rebel Yao Zhifu secretly crossed the Gun River from Huanglong'ang and fled into Henan; commander-in-chief Yong Bao was dismissed and Huiling replaced him, hurrying to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Xiangyang rebel Yao Zhifu secretly crossed the Gun River from Huanglong'ang and fled into Henan; Yong Bao was removed as commander-in-chief and replaced by Huiling, who hurried to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「襄、鄧平衍，無險可扼。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Xiang and Deng are level and open, with no terrain that can be held.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Xiangyang and Dengzhou are flat and open, with no defensible terrain.

sentences.zh: 賊習地勢，必不自趨絕地。

translations.literal: The rebels know the terrain and will certainly not drive themselves into dead ends.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels know the terrain and will not drive themselves into a dead end.

sentences.zh: 惟有嚴防漢江潛渡，並堰唐河、白河，移難民於河西，守岸團練以蹙賊。」

translations.literal: We must only strictly guard against secret crossings of the Han River, dam the Tang and Bai rivers, move refugees to the west bank, and hold the shore with militia to hem in the rebels."
translations.idiomatic: We must strictly guard against secret crossings of the Han River, dam the Tang and Bai rivers, move refugees to the west bank, and hold the shore with militia to hem in the rebels."

sentences.zh: 會之富折回湖北境，惠齡迎擊，遏其西軼，敗之茅茨畈，分兵五路兜剿。

translations.literal: Just then Yao Zhifu turned back into Hubei; Huiling met the attack, blocked his westward flight, defeated him at Maocipan, and divided the army into five columns for encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Yao Zhifu turned back into Hubei; Huiling met him in battle, blocked his westward flight, defeated him at Maocipan, and divided his forces into five columns for encirclement.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，敗賊於鮑家畈，擒賊首劉起榮；

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year he defeated the rebels at Baojiapan and captured the rebel chief Liu Qirong;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year he defeated the rebels at Baojiapan and captured the rebel chief Liu Qirong;

sentences.zh: 复敗賊於曾家店，鏖戰於鄭家河，殲獲甚眾，賞雙眼花翎，擢理籓院尚書，兼鑲白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: again defeated them at Zengjiadian and fought fiercely at Zhengjiahe, destroying and capturing a great number; he was awarded double-eyed peacock feathers, promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and also made commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated them at Zengjiadian and fought a fierce battle at Zhengjiahe, killing and capturing a great number; he was awarded double-eyed peacock feathers, promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and appointed commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 惠齡偕恆瑞、慶成剿襄陽賊，屢破之，餘眾僅數千，勢甚蹙，分路竄河南境，官軍疲於尾追，不易得一戰，先後併入陝西，遂復猖獗。

translations.literal: Huiling with Hengrui and Qingcheng suppressed the Xiangyang rebels and repeatedly defeated them; the remainder numbered only a few thousand and their situation was very tight; they split into columns and fled into Henan, the government army grew weary from pursuit and could not easily gain a battle, and they successively merged into Shaanxi and again grew rampant.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling, together with Hengrui and Qingcheng, campaigned against the Xiangyang rebels and defeated them repeatedly; only a few thousand remained and were hard pressed. They split into columns and fled into Henan; government forces, exhausted from pursuit, could not bring them to battle, and the rebels successively entered Shaanxi and grew rampant again.

sentences.zh: 五月，李全、王廷詔、姚之富合為一路，由紫陽白馬石竄渡漢江，後五日，惠齡始至，奪宮銜、世職、花翎，易宜綿總統軍務，降惠齡為領隊，聽節制。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, and Yao Zhifu united as one band and fled across the Han River via Baimashi in Ziyang. Five days later Huiling finally arrived. He was stripped of court rank, hereditary office, and peacock feathers; Yi Mian replaced him as commander-in-chief of military affairs; Huiling was demoted to column leader, subject to command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, and Yao Zhifu united as one force and slipped across the Han River at Baimashi in Ziyang. Huiling did not arrive until five days later. He was stripped of his court rank, hereditary office, and peacock feathers; Yi Mian replaced him as commander-in-chief of military affairs, and Huiling was demoted to column leader under his command.

sentences.zh: 賊既分竄入川，十月，王廷詔、高均德复北犯，窺渡漢江，惠齡邀擊敗之，斬賊二千。

translations.literal: After the rebels had scattered and fled into Sichuan, in the tenth month Wang Tingzhao and Gao Junde again raided north, seeking to cross the Han River. Huiling intercepted and defeated them, beheading two thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels had scattered into Sichuan, Wang Tingzhao and Gao Junde again raided north in the tenth month, seeking to cross the Han River. Huiling intercepted them, defeated them, and beheaded two thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其僅兵二千當賊二萬，以​​少擊眾，复雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: An edict praised him for facing twenty thousand rebels with only two thousand men, striking the many with the few, and restored his double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended him for facing twenty thousand rebels with only two thousand men— striking the many with the few— and restored his double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 十一月，齊王氏、張漢潮、姚之富、高均德合入漢中南山，自黃官嶺至新集，連營二十里，欲渡漢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Qi Wangshi, Zhang Hanchao, Yao Zhifu, and Gao Junde united and entered the southern mountains of Hanzhong. From Huangguan Ridge to Xiji they strung camps along twenty li, intending to cross the Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Qi Wangshi, Zhang Hanchao, Yao Zhifu, and Gao Junde united and entered the southern mountains of Hanzhong. From Huangguan Ridge to Xiji they strung camps for twenty li, intending to cross the Han River.

sentences.zh: 惠齡軍北岸，蹙其半濟，賊走寧羌，追敗之，折竄漢中。

translations.literal: Huiling's army was on the north bank. He pressed them at mid-crossing; the rebels fled to Ningqiang. Pursuing, he defeated them and turned them back into Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling's army held the north bank. He pressed the rebels while they were half across the river; they fled to Ningqiang, and pursuing them he defeated them and drove them back into Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 因移兵扼漢南，賊不得北竄，復分道入川，惠齡繞由西鄉、太平赴大寧、夔州兜剿。

translations.literal: Accordingly he shifted troops to block the south bank of the Han; the rebels could not flee north. They again split and entered Sichuan. Huiling looped through Xixiang and Taiping to pursue toward Daming and Kuizhou for encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: He then shifted troops to block the south bank of the Han, preventing the rebels from fleeing north. They again split and entered Sichuan, and Huiling looped through Xixiang and Taiping to pursue them toward Daming and Kuizhou in an encirclement campaign.

sentences.zh: 時川匪王三槐、徐天德竄梁山，羅其清、冉文儔分屯營山、儀隴。

translations.literal: At that time the Sichuan bandits Wang Sanhuai and Xu Tiande were lurking at Liangshan; Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu separately encamped at Yingshan and Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Sichuan bandits Wang Sanhuai and Xu Tiande were lurking at Liangshan, while Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu separately encamped at Yingshan and Yilong.

sentences.zh: 三年，陝、襄諸賊在川境者俱會於文儔，而三槐、天德自太平走與合，勢張甚。

translations.literal: In the third year all the Shaanxi and Xiangyang rebels in Sichuan territory gathered with Wenfu, while Sanhuai and Tiande fled from Taiping to join them— their power swelled greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year all the Shaanxi and Xiangyang rebels within Sichuan gathered with Wenfu, while Sanhuai and Tiande fled from Taiping to join them, and their strength swelled greatly.

sentences.zh: 詔總統勒保會諸將，分路進剿，惠齡與德楞泰為一路，夾攻羅、冉二賊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered commander-in-chief Le Bao to gather the generals for multi-route advance. Huiling and Delengtai formed one column and attacked Luo and Ran in a pincer.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered commander-in-chief Le Bao to gather the generals for a multi-pronged advance. Huiling and Delengtai formed one column and attacked the rebels Luo and Ran in a pincer.

sentences.zh: 五月，擊文儔於儀隴，其清及阮正通先後來援，皆敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he struck Wenfu at Yilong. Qiqing and Ruan Zhengtong came to reinforce in succession; all were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he attacked Wenfu at Yilong. Qiqing and Ruan Zhengtong came to reinforce in succession, and all were defeated.

sentences.zh: 賊屯大神山，連營數十里，六月，與德楞泰合攻，破之，斬賊甚眾。

translations.literal: The rebels encamped at Dashen Mountain in camps stretching dozens of li. In the sixth month, joining Delengtai in attack, they broke them and beheaded a great many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels encamped at Dashen Mountain in camps stretching for dozens of li. In the sixth month Huiling joined Delengtai in attack, broke their position, and beheaded a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 文儔走箕山龍鳳坪，與其清相犄角，阮正通等又與合。

translations.literal: Wenfu fled to Longfeng Ping on Jishan, forming a horn formation with Qiqing; Ruan Zhengtong and others again joined with them.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu fled to Longfeng Ping on Jishan and formed a pincer formation with Qiqing; Ruan Zhengtong and others again joined them.

sentences.zh: 帝以首逆稽誅，屢詔嚴責，於是德楞泰破賊箕山，其清​​奔天鵬寨，惠齡分路進攻，十二月，其清就擒，檻送京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the chief rebel long evaded execution, repeatedly issued edicts of stern rebuke. Thereupon Delengtai broke the rebels at Jishan; Qiqing fled to Tianpeng Stockade. Huiling advanced by separate routes; in the twelfth month Qiqing was captured and sent to the capital in a caged cart.
translations.idiomatic: Because the chief rebel long evaded capture, the Emperor repeatedly issued stern rebukes. Delengtai then broke the rebels at Jishan; Qiqing fled to Tianpeng Stockade. Huiling advanced by separate routes, and in the twelfth month Qiqing was captured and sent to the capital in a caged cart.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，文儔就擒，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Wenfu was captured; Huiling was granted a hereditary first-rank commandancy of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year Wenfu was captured, and Huiling was granted a hereditary first-rank commandancy of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，會其清讞詞稱惠齡一軍較弱，帝斥其為賊所輕，命回京守制，降兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: During mourning for his mother, Qiqing's trial testimony said Huiling's army was relatively weak. The Emperor rebuked him for being held in contempt by the rebels, ordered him back to the capital to observe mourning, and demoted him to vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: While mourning his mother, Qiqing's trial testimony stated that Huiling's army was relatively weak. The Emperor rebuked him for being held in contempt by the rebels, ordered him back to the capital to observe mourning, and demoted him to vice minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 尋授山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was appointed governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢陝甘總督，專剿南山餘匪。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu to specialize in suppressing remnant bandits in the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu and charged with suppressing the remnant bandits in the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 復以勦賊遲緩，降二品頂戴。

translations.literal: Again, for slow progress in suppressing rebels, his second-rank official's button was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Again, for slow progress in suppressing rebels, he was demoted in his second-rank official's button.

sentences.zh: 七年，教匪平，复頭品頂戴、花翎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the sect rebels were pacified, his top-rank button and peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the sect rebels were pacified, his top-rank button and peacock feathers were restored.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，贈太子少保，封二等男，諡勤襄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died. He was posthumously given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed as a second-rank baron, with the posthumous name Qinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed as a second-rank baron, and given the posthumous name Qinxiang.

sentences.zh: 子桂斌，官和闐幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: His son Guibin served as assistant commissioner of Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guibin served as assistant commissioner of Khotan.

sentences.zh: 宜綿，初名尚安，鄂濟氏，漢洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Yi Mian— originally named Shang'an— was of the Eji clan, a Hanzhou bannerman of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian, originally named Shang'an, was of the Eji clan and a Hanzhou bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由兵部筆帖式充軍機章京，累遷員外郎。

translations.literal: Starting as a clerk in the Board of War, he served as a Grand Council clerk and was promoted through stages to director.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a clerk in the Board of War, he served as a Grand Council clerk and was promoted through stages to director.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，進郎中。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Jinchuan, he was promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: While campaigning in Jinchuan he was promoted to department director.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十三年，出為直隸口北道，擢陝西布政使。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Qianlong he went out as intendant of Koubei Circuit in Zhili and was promoted to financial commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year of the Qianlong reign he was posted as intendant of Koubei Circuit in Zhili and promoted to financial commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，擢廣東巡撫，以鹽商沈翼川獄瞻徇，褫職，戍新疆。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong. For showing favor in the case of the salt merchant Shen Yichuan, he was stripped of office and exiled to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong, but for showing favor in the case of the salt merchant Shen Yichuan he was stripped of office and exiled to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 尋予四品銜，充吐魯番領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was given a fourth-rank nominal rank and appointed column leader of Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was given a fourth-rank nominal rank and appointed column leader of Turpan.

sentences.zh: 石峰堡回亂，駐守平涼。

translations.literal: During the Muslim uprising at Shifeng Fort he was stationed to garrison Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Muslim uprising at Shifeng Fort he was stationed to garrison Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 歷庫車、喀什噶爾辦事大臣，烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: He successively served as commissioner at Kuche and Kashgar and as military governor of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as commissioner at Kuche and Kashgar and as military governor of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，入覲，道經固關，值水災，飭官吏賑撫，高宗嘉之，命改名宜綿。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he came to court for audience. Passing through Gu Pass he encountered flooding; he ordered officials to provide relief. The Gaozong Emperor commended this and ordered him renamed Yi Mian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he came to court for audience. Passing through Gu Pass he encountered flooding and ordered officials to provide relief. The Gaozong Emperor commended this and ordered him renamed Yi Mian.

sentences.zh: 六十年，授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，教匪起，湖北、陝西戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the sect rebels rose; Hubei and Shaanxi were placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign the sect rebels rose, and Hubei and Shaanxi were placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 宜綿駐軍商州，令副將百祥剿鄖陽、鄖西賊，克孤山大寨，賊首王全禮伏誅，漢江以北安堵，加太子太保，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Yi Mian stationed his army at Shangzhou and ordered the vice general Baixiang to suppress rebels in Yunyang and Yunxi. He stormed the great stockade at Gushan; the rebel chief Wang Quanli was executed. North of the Han River was settled. He was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and awarded double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian stationed his army at Shangzhou and ordered Vice General Baixiang to suppress rebels in Yunyang and Yunxi. He stormed the great stockade at Gushan, the rebel chief Wang Quanli was executed, and the region north of the Han River was pacified. Yi Mian was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and awarded double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 甘肅歲祲，命宜綿回蘭洲賑撫。

translations.literal: Gansu suffered famine; Yi Mian was ordered back to Lanzhou for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu suffered famine, and Yi Mian was ordered back to Lanzhou to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，四川教匪起，由太平入陝境，擾安康、平利、紫陽諸縣，宜綿督軍馳剿，賊逼興安，分踞城南安嶺、城北將軍山，進攻克之，擒其渠王可秀、馮得士等。

translations.literal: That winter Sichuan sect rebels rose, entered Shaanxi from Taiping, and harassed Ankang, Pingli, Ziyang, and other counties. Yi Mian personally led troops in rapid suppression. The rebels pressed upon Xing'an, dividing to hold Nan'an Ridge south of the city and Jiangjun Mountain north of the city. Advancing, he stormed them and captured the chiefs Wang Kexiu, Feng Deshi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Sichuan sect rebels rose, entered Shaanxi from Taiping, and harassed Ankang, Pingli, Ziyang, and other counties. Yi Mian personally led troops in rapid suppression. The rebels pressed upon Xing'an, dividing to hold Nan'an Ridge south of the city and Jiangjun Mountain north of the city. Advancing, he stormed both positions and captured the chiefs Wang Kexiu, Feng Deshi, and others.

sentences.zh: 复殲漢江北岸大小米溪賊。

translations.literal: Again he annihilated the rebels at Daxiao Mixi on the north bank of the Han.
translations.idiomatic: He again annihilated the rebels at Daxiao Mixi on the north bank of the Han River.

sentences.zh: 偕提督柯籓、總兵索費英阿移攻漢南洞河、汝河諸賊，賊並五云寨，乘雪夜火其寨，殲馘甚眾，詔宜綿進剿達州。

translations.literal: Together with Regional Commander Ke Fan and Brigadier Suofiying'a he shifted to attack rebels at Donghe and Ruhe south of the Han. The rebels gathered at Wuyun Stockade; on a snowy night he set fire to the stockade and killed or captured a great number. An edict ordered Yi Mian to advance suppression to Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Regional Commander Ke Fan and Brigadier Suofiying'a he shifted to attack rebels at Donghe and Ruhe south of the Han. The rebels gathered at Wuyun Stockade; on a snowy night he set fire to the stockade and killed or captured a great number. An edict then ordered Yi Mian to advance the suppression into Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 二年春，攻太平賊於通天觀、高家寨、南津關，連敗之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he attacked Taiping rebels at Tongtian Temple, Gaojia Stockade, and Nanjin Pass, defeating them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year he attacked Taiping rebels at Tongtian Temple, Gaojia Stockade, and Nanjin Pass, defeating them in succession.

sentences.zh: 川匪最悍者，達州徐天德，東鄉王三槐、冷天祿，巴州羅其清，通江冉文儔。

translations.literal: The fiercest Sichuan bandits were Xu Tiande of Dazhou, Wang Sanhuai and Leng Tianlu of Dongxiang, Luo Qiqing of Bazhou, and Ran Wenfu of Tongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The fiercest Sichuan bandits were Xu Tiande of Dazhou, Wang Sanhuai and Leng Tianlu of Dongxiang, Luo Qiqing of Bazhou, and Ran Wenfu of Tongjiang.

sentences.zh: 天德、三槐等合陷東鄉，踞張家觀；

translations.literal: Tiande, Sanhuai, and the others jointly seized Dongxiang and held Zhangjia Temple;
translations.idiomatic: Tiande, Sanhuai, and the others jointly seized Dongxiang and held Zhangjia Temple;

sentences.zh: 其清踞方山坪，文儔竄王家寨，圖據周家河，梗運道，且乘間與張家觀合。

translations.literal: Qiqing held Fangshan Ping; Wenfu lurked at Wangjia Stockade, intending to seize Zhoujia River, block the supply route, and at an opportune moment join with Zhangjia Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing held Fangshan Ping; Wenfu lurked at Wangjia Stockade, intending to seize Zhoujia River, block the supply route, and join with Zhangjia Temple when an opportunity arose.

sentences.zh: 宜綿遣兵攻王家寨，分襲張家觀，自率隊夜焚曾家山賊柵，天德分援兩路，遂乘虛下張家觀，復東鄉；

translations.literal: Yi Mian sent troops to attack Wangjia Stockade and divided forces to strike Zhangjia Temple. He personally led a column to burn the rebel palisade at Zengjia Mountain by night. Tiande split reinforcements to both routes; Yi Mian then exploited the opening to take Zhangjia Temple and recover Dongxiang;
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian sent troops to attack Wangjia Stockade and divided forces to strike Zhangjia Temple. He personally led a column to burn the rebel palisade at Zengjia Mountain by night. Tiande split his reinforcements between the two routes, and Yi Mian then exploited the opening to take Zhangjia Temple and recover Dongxiang;

sentences.zh: 餘賊奔清溪場、金峨寺，據險抗拒，四月，官軍分五路進克之。

translations.literal: The remaining rebels fled to Qingxi Market and Jin'e Temple, holding rugged terrain in resistance. In the fourth month the government army advanced in five columns and stormed them.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels fled to Qingxi Market and Jin'e Temple and held rugged terrain in resistance. In the fourth month the government army advanced in five columns and stormed them.

sentences.zh: 天德等竄重石子、香爐坪，將與巴州賊合。

translations.literal: Tiande and the others fled to Chongshizi and Xianglu Ping, intending to join with the Bazhou rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande and the others fled to Chongshizi and Xianglu Ping, intending to join with the Bazhou rebels.

sentences.zh: 宜綿潛攻王家寨，賊走方山坪，天德來援，敗之。

translations.literal: Yi Mian secretly attacked Wangjia Stockade; the rebels fled to Fangshan Ping. Tiande came to reinforce; Yi Mian defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian secretly attacked Wangjia Stockade; the rebels fled to Fangshan Ping. When Tiande came to reinforce them, Yi Mian defeated him.

sentences.zh: 知縣劉清素得民心，令招諭諸賊，三槐率眾詭降，陰圖襲營，宜綿覺其詐，設伏擊退。

translations.literal: Magistrate Liu Qing had long won the people's hearts; Yi Mian ordered him to summon and persuade the rebels. Sanhuai led the masses in feigned surrender while secretly plotting a surprise attack on camp. Yi Mian detected the ruse and set an ambush, beating them back.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Liu Qing had long won the people's hearts, and Yi Mian ordered him to summon and persuade the rebels. Sanhuai led his followers in feigned surrender while secretly plotting a surprise attack on camp. Yi Mian detected the ruse, set an ambush, and beat them back.

sentences.zh: 五月，達州賊傾巢出犯，有備不得逞。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Dazhou rebels poured out in full force; the army was prepared and they could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Dazhou rebels poured out in full force, but the army was prepared and they could not succeed.

sentences.zh: 宜綿駐軍大成寨，遣將襲三槐於毛坪，三槐中槍跳免。

translations.literal: Yi Mian stationed his army at Dacheng Stockade and sent a general to strike Sanhuai at Maoping. Sanhuai was shot but leaped away and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian stationed his army at Dacheng Stockade and sent a general to strike Sanhuai at Maoping. Sanhuai was shot but leaped away and escaped.

sentences.zh: 時襄賊由漢江北渡入陝，署總督陸有仁以罪逮，乃調英善督陝甘，黜惠齡總統，命宜綿代之，兼攝四川總督。

translations.literal: At that time Xiangyang rebels crossed the Han northward into Shaanxi. Acting Governor-General Lu Youren was arrested for his offenses. Yingshan was transferred to oversee Shaanxi-Gansu; Huiling was removed as commander-in-chief; Yi Mian was ordered to replace him, also acting as governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiangyang rebels crossed the Han River northward into Shaanxi. Acting Governor-General Lu Youren was arrested for his offenses. Yingshan was transferred to oversee Shaanxi-Gansu, Huiling was removed as commander-in-chief, and Yi Mian was ordered to replace him while also acting as governor of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 於是令明亮攻重石子，德楞泰與鄉勇羅思舉夾擊敗之，分二路竄，追殲孫士鳳於磨子壩。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mingliang was ordered to attack Chongshizi. Delengtai and the militia leader Luo Siju struck in pincer and defeated them. They split and fled in two bands; Sun Shifeng was pursued and destroyed at Moziba.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Mingliang was ordered to attack Chongshizi. Delengtai and the militia leader Luo Siju struck in a pincer and defeated them. The rebels split and fled in two bands, and Sun Shifeng was pursued and destroyed at Moziba.

sentences.zh: 士鳳為四川教首，三槐等皆其徒也，至是為德楞泰所誅。

translations.literal: Shifeng was the chief leader of the Sichuan sect; Sanhuai and the others were all his disciples. At this point he was executed by Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: Shifeng was the chief leader of the Sichuan sect, and Sanhuai and the others were all his disciples. At this point he was executed by Delengtai.

sentences.zh: 餘賊西走徐家山，乘霧夜遁。

translations.literal: The remaining rebels fled west to Xujiashan and escaped under cover of fog by night.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels fled west to Xujiashan and escaped under cover of fog by night.

sentences.zh: 其方山坪賊為百祥所截，舒亮圍賊林亮工於巴​​州白崖山，觀成、劉君輔破大寧賊，圍之​​於老木園，川賊漸蹙；

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Fangshan Ping rebels were cut off by Baixiang. Shuliang besieged the rebel Lin Lianggong at Baiya Mountain in Bazhou. Guancheng and Liu Junfu defeated the Daming rebels and besieged them at Laomuyuan; the Sichuan rebels were gradually pressed;
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Fangshan Ping rebels were cut off by Baixiang. Shuliang besieged the rebel Lin Lianggong at Baiya Mountain in Bazhou. Guancheng and Liu Junfu defeated the Daming rebels and besieged them at Laomuyuan, and the Sichuan rebels were gradually pressed;

sentences.zh: 而襄陽賊李全、王廷詔、姚之富等由陝分道入川，與之響應，勢复熾。

translations.literal: but the Xiangyang rebels Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, Yao Zhifu, and others entered Sichuan by separate routes from Shaanxi and responded to them— their power again flared.
translations.idiomatic: but the Xiangyang rebels Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, Yao Zhifu, and others entered Sichuan by separate routes from Shaanxi and responded to them, and their strength again flared.

sentences.zh: 雲陽賊伏陳家山，與襄賊約犯官軍，為羅思舉所殲。

translations.literal: Yunyang rebels lay in ambush at Chenjia Mountain, agreeing with the Xiangyang rebels to attack the government army; they were destroyed by Luo Siju.
translations.idiomatic: Yunyang rebels lay in ambush at Chenjia Mountain, agreeing with the Xiangyang rebels to attack the government army, and were destroyed by Luo Siju.

sentences.zh: 李全等踞開縣南天洞、火焰壩，旋奔雲安場，開、萬諸匪應之，謀犯夔州，附近賊蜂起，詔責宜綿專剿。

translations.literal: Li Quan and the others held Nantian Cave and Huoyan Dam in Kaixian, then fled to Yun'an Market. Bandits of Kaixian and Wanxian responded. They plotted to attack Kuizhou; nearby rebels swarmed. An edict rebuked Yi Mian to concentrate on suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan and the others held Nantian Cave and Huoyan Dam in Kaixian, then fled to Yun'an Market. Bandits of Kaixian and Wanxian responded, and they plotted to attack Kuizhou as nearby rebels swarmed. An edict rebuked Yi Mian and ordered him to concentrate on suppression.

sentences.zh: 七月，駐軍竇山關，開縣、東鄉交界地也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he stationed his army at Doushan Pass, on the border of Kaixian and Dongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he stationed his army at Doushan Pass, on the border between Kaixian and Dongxiang.

sentences.zh: 川賊分立名號：羅其清稱白號，冉文儔稱藍號，踞方山坪；

translations.literal: The Sichuan rebels took separate designations: Luo Qiqing called himself the White Banner, Ran Wenfu the Blue Banner, holding Fangshan Ping;
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan rebels took separate designations: Luo Qiqing called himself the White Banner and Ran Wenfu the Blue Banner, holding Fangshan Ping;

sentences.zh: 王三槐稱白號，徐天德稱青號，踞尖山坪。

translations.literal: Wang Sanhuai called himself the White Banner and Xu Tiande the Green Banner, holding Jianshan Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sanhuai called himself the White Banner and Xu Tiande the Green Banner, holding Jianshan Ping.

sentences.zh: 劉清率鄉勇與百祥、硃射鬥會剿方山坪，賊潰圍竄通江、巴州，與天德合。

translations.literal: Liu Qing led militia with Baixiang and Zhushedou to jointly suppress Fangshan Ping. The rebels broke out and fled to Tongjiang and Bazhou, joining Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qing led militia with Baixiang and Zhushedou in a joint campaign against Fangshan Ping. The rebels broke out and fled to Tongjiang and Bazhou, joining Tiande.

sentences.zh: 既而天德等竄青杠渡，圍巴州，其清、文儔欲從儀隴、南部分犯保寧，奪官軍餉道，百祥扼其前，退走黃渡河，旁掠儀隴；

translations.literal: Soon Tiande and the others fled to Qinggang Ford and besieged Bazhou. Qiqing and Wenfu intended to invade Baoning from Yilong and Nanbu, seizing the government army's supply route. Baixiang blocked their front; they retreated to Huangdu River and pillaged Yilong on the flank;
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tiande and the others fled to Qinggang Ford and besieged Bazhou. Qiqing and Wenfu intended to invade Baoning from Yilong and Nanbu and seize the government army's supply route. Baixiang blocked their front; they retreated to Huangdu River and pillaged Yilong on the flank;

sentences.zh: 宜綿扼之官渡口，三槐等竄渠縣，其清、文儔走巴州。

translations.literal: Yi Mian blocked them at Guandu Ford. Sanhuai and the others fled to Quxian; Qiqing and Wenfu fled to Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian blocked them at Guandu Ford. Sanhuai and the others fled to Quxian, while Qiqing and Wenfu fled to Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 三槐復分攻鄰水，陷長壽，東趨重慶。

translations.literal: Sanhuai again split forces to attack Linshui, seized Changshou, and pressed east toward Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Sanhuai again split his forces to attack Linshui, seized Changshou, and pressed east toward Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 時齊王氏、姚之富已竄湖北，李全、高均德先後分竄陝西。

translations.literal: At that time Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu had already fled to Hubei; Li Quan and Gao Junde successively split and fled to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu had already fled to Hubei, while Li Quan and Gao Junde successively split and fled to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 宜綿疏言：「惠齡、恆瑞、明亮、德楞泰皆入陝，惟臣一人在川。

translations.literal: Yi Mian memorialized: "Huiling, Hengrui, Mingliang, and Delengtai have all entered Shaanxi; only this minister remains in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian memorialized: "Huiling, Hengrui, Mingliang, and Delengtai have all entered Shaanxi; only I remain in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 諸賊齊擾川東北運道，嘉陵江防孔亟，欲親赴保寧，則川東千里無人調度。

translations.literal: All the rebels together harass the northeast Sichuan supply route; defense of the Jialing River is urgently needed. If I wish to go personally to Baoning, then for a thousand li in eastern Sichuan there will be no one to command.
translations.idiomatic: All the rebels together harass the northeast Sichuan supply route, and defense of the Jialing River is urgently needed. If I go personally to Baoning, then for a thousand li in eastern Sichuan there will be no one to command.

sentences.zh: 請別簡總督治理地方，而己親督師專一辦賊。」

translations.literal: I request that another governor be specially selected to administer local affairs, while I personally command the army and devote myself solely to suppressing rebels."
translations.idiomatic: I request that another governor be specially selected to administer local affairs, while I personally command the army and devote myself solely to suppressing the rebels."

sentences.zh: 帝亦以宜綿年老，十月，命勒保總統軍務，宜綿以總督兼理軍需。

translations.literal: The Emperor also considered Yi Mian old. In the tenth month Le Bao was ordered to command military affairs; Yi Mian as governor also managed military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor also considered Yi Mian too old. In the tenth month Le Bao was ordered to command military affairs, while Yi Mian as governor also managed military supplies.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「軍興以來，四川調兵一萬九千有奇，陝、甘合調二萬有奇，兩湖更無餘兵可調。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Since the war began, Sichuan has mobilized over nineteen thousand troops; Shaanxi and Gansu together over twenty thousand; the Two Hu regions have no surplus troops to mobilize.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Since the war began, Sichuan has mobilized over nineteen thousand troops, Shaanxi and Gansu together over twenty thousand, and the Two Hu regions have no surplus troops to mobilize.

sentences.zh: 各省募補者難備攻剿；

translations.literal: Recruits supplemented from the provinces are hard to prepare for assault and suppression;
translations.idiomatic: Recruits supplemented from the provinces are ill suited for assault and suppression;

sentences.zh: 州縣團勇，各衛村莊，尤難責其長驅赴敵。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county militia, each guarding their villages, are especially hard to charge with long-range pursuit of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county militia, each guarding their own villages, are especially hard to charge with long-range pursuit of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 目前賊勢，明亮、德楞泰至襄陽，則鄖賊竄興安，宜昌賊回夔、巫；

translations.literal: The present rebel situation: when Mingliang and Delengtai reach Xiangyang, the Yunyang rebels flee to Xing'an and the Yichang rebels return to Kuizhou and Wushan;
translations.idiomatic: The present rebel situation is this: when Mingliang and Delengtai reach Xiangyang, the Yunyang rebels flee to Xing'an and the Yichang rebels return to Kuizhou and Wushan;

sentences.zh: 況雲陽、奉節伏莽尚多，兵力日分日薄。

translations.literal: Moreover in Yunyang and Fengjie hidden rebels still abound; military strength grows more divided and thin by the day.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, hidden rebels still abound in Yunyang and Fengjie, and military strength grows more divided and thin by the day.

sentences.zh: 請敕添練備戰之兵，四川、陝甘、湖北各五千。

translations.literal: I request an edict to add trained troops ready for battle— five thousand each for Sichuan, Shaanxi-Gansu, and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: I request an edict to add trained troops ready for battle— five thousand each for Sichuan, Shaanxi-Gansu, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 至隨營鄉勇，費與兵等，賞過則驕，威過則散，究非紀律之師。

translations.literal: As for camp-attached militia, their cost equals that of regular troops; excessive rewards make them arrogant, excessive severity makes them scatter— they are ultimately not disciplined troops.
translations.idiomatic: As for camp-attached militia, their cost equals that of regular troops; excessive rewards make them arrogant, excessive severity makes them scatter— they are ultimately not a disciplined force.

sentences.zh: 不若選充營伍，賊平即補營額，費不虛糜，而驍悍有所約束。」

translations.literal: Better to select them to fill regular battalions; when rebels are pacified they can at once fill regular quotas— expense will not be wasted, and their ferocity will be subject to restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Better to select them to fill regular battalions; when the rebels are pacified they can at once fill regular quotas— expense will not be wasted, and their ferocity will be subject to restraint.

sentences.zh: 詔行之。

translations.literal: The edict approved and carried this out.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved and carried this out.

sentences.zh: 三年春，調勒保四川總督，宜綿回任陝甘，駐陝境辦賊。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year Le Bao was transferred to governor of Sichuan; Yi Mian returned to his post as governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu, stationed in Shaanxi territory to handle rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year Le Bao was transferred to governor of Sichuan; Yi Mian returned to his post as governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu and was stationed in Shaanxi territory to handle the rebels.

sentences.zh: 未幾，高均德、齊王氏竄漢陰，褫明亮職，命宜綿赴軍督剿；

translations.literal: Before long Gao Junde and Qi Wangshi fled to Hanyin. Mingliang was stripped of office; Yi Mian was ordered to the front to supervise suppression;
translations.idiomatic: Before long Gao Junde and Qi Wangshi fled to Hanyin. Mingliang was stripped of office, and Yi Mian was ordered to the front to supervise the suppression;

sentences.zh: 而齊王氏、姚之富已為德楞泰、明亮所殲，阮正通、張漢潮先後犯陝境，川賊劉成棟走與合。

translations.literal: but Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu had already been destroyed by Delengtai and Mingliang. Ruan Zhengtong and Zhang Hanchao successively invaded Shaanxi territory; the Sichuan rebel Liu Chengdong fled to join them.
translations.idiomatic: but Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu had already been destroyed by Delengtai and Mingliang. Ruan Zhengtong and Zhang Hanchao successively invaded Shaanxi territory, and the Sichuan rebel Liu Chengdong fled to join them.

sentences.zh: 宜綿自鎮安分路截剿，漢潮折向通江、巴州，正通竄城固，李全與高均德合屯五郎、鎮安、山陽間。

translations.literal: Yi Mian from Zhen'an divided routes for interception. Hanchao turned toward Tongjiang and Bazhou; Zhengtong fled to Chenggu. Li Quan and Gao Junde united and encamped between Wulang, Zhen'an, and Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian from Zhen'an divided his forces for interception. Hanchao turned toward Tongjiang and Bazhou; Zhengtong fled to Chenggu. Li Quan and Gao Junde united and encamped between Wulang, Zhen'an, and Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 宜綿偕明亮要之雒南，鏖戰兩河口，均德竄秦嶺，正通折入川。

translations.literal: Yi Mian with Mingliang intercepted them at Luonan and fought fiercely at Lianghekou. Junde fled into the Qin Mountains; Zhengtong turned into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian with Mingliang intercepted them at Luonan and fought fiercely at Lianghekou. Junde fled into the Qin Mountains, and Zhengtong turned into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五月，賊分股北出鳳縣，掠兩當，闌入甘境，詔斥宜綿疏防。

translations.literal: In the fifth month rebels split north from Fengxian, plundered Liangdang, and barged into Gansu territory. An edict rebuked Yi Mian for lax defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month rebels split north from Fengxian, plundered Liangdang, and barged into Gansu territory. An edict rebuked Yi Mian for lax defense.

sentences.zh: 既而明亮敗賊於略陽，成棟、漢潮復由竹谿竄平利。

translations.literal: Soon Mingliang defeated rebels at Lueyang. Chengdong and Hanchao again fled from Zhuxi to Pingli.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Mingliang defeated rebels at Lueyang. Chengdong and Hanchao again fled from Zhuxi to Pingli.

sentences.zh: 命宜綿與額勒登保為一路，專剿平利之賊，尋敗之於孟石嶺，賊遁入川，責宜綿嚴遏回竄。

translations.literal: Yi Mian and Eledengbao were ordered as one column to specialize in suppressing the Pingli rebels. Soon they were defeated at Mengshi Ridge; the rebels fled into Sichuan. Yi Mian was charged to strictly block their return flight.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian and Eledengbao were ordered as one column to specialize in suppressing the Pingli rebels. Soon they were defeated at Mengshi Ridge and the rebels fled into Sichuan. Yi Mian was charged to strictly block their return flight.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐天德、冉文儔、高均德由儀隴竄廣元，漢潮北入南江，欲還湖北，官軍蹙之上游不得渡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xu Tiande, Ran Wenfu, and Gao Junde fled from Yilong to Guangyuan. Hanchao entered Nanjiang from the north, intending to return to Hubei; the government army pressed them upstream and they could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xu Tiande, Ran Wenfu, and Gao Junde fled from Yilong to Guangyuan. Hanchao entered Nanjiang from the north, intending to return to Hubei, but the government army pressed them upstream and they could not cross.

sentences.zh: 宜綿檄兵扼寧羌、沔縣，漢潮竄太平。

translations.literal: Yi Mian dispatched troops to block Ningqiang and Mianxian. Hanchao fled to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian dispatched troops to block Ningqiang and Mianxian. Hanchao fled to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 於是川、楚匪多流入陝境，其魁樊人傑、龍紹週、李澍、阮正漋各擁眾數千，迭擾安康、平利、紫陽諸縣。

translations.literal: Thereupon many Sichuan and Huguang bandits poured into Shaanxi territory. Their chiefs Fan Renjie, Long Shaozhou, Li Shu, and Ruan Zhengkong each commanded thousands, successively harassing Ankang, Pingli, Ziyang, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon many Sichuan and Huguang bandits poured into Shaanxi territory. Their chiefs Fan Renjie, Long Shaozhou, Li Shu, and Ruan Zhengkong each commanded thousands and successively harassed Ankang, Pingli, Ziyang, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 四年，漢潮竄五郎，詔斥宜綿畏葸避賊，命解任來京，在散秩大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Hanchao fled to Wulang. An edict rebuked Yi Mian for timidity and avoiding rebels, ordered him relieved and to come to the capital, serving among senior ministers without regular rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Hanchao fled to Wulang. An edict rebuked Yi Mian for timidity and avoiding the rebels, ordered him relieved and to come to the capital, and assigned him to serve among senior ministers without regular rank.

sentences.zh: 既至，复斥其辨飾，降三等侍衛，赴烏里雅蘇台辦事。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, he was again rebuked for evasive excuses, demoted to third-class bodyguard, and sent to serve at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Once he arrived, he was again rebuked for evasive excuses, demoted to third-class bodyguard, and sent to serve at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 五年，追論軍需冒濫，褫職，遣戍伊犁，罰銀二萬兩助餉，逾兩年釋回。

translations.literal: In the fifth year past military supply abuses were reviewed; he was stripped of office, exiled to garrison at Yili, fined twenty thousand taels of silver to aid supplies; after more than two years he was released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year past military supply abuses were reviewed; he was stripped of office, exiled to garrison at Yili, and fined twenty thousand taels of silver to aid supplies. After more than two years he was released and returned.

sentences.zh: 及三省教匪平，以員外郎用。

translations.literal: When the three provinces' sect rebels were pacified, he was employed as a director.
translations.idiomatic: When the sect rebels in the three provinces were pacified, he was employed as a director.

sentences.zh: 後帝閱方略，宜綿曾論鄉勇，切中時弊，追念前勞，擢大理寺卿。

translations.literal: Later the Emperor reviewed the military chronicle. Yi Mian's former analysis of militia had hit the abuses of the time; recalling his earlier service, he was promoted to chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Emperor reviewed the military chronicle. Yi Mian's former analysis of militia had hit the abuses of the time; recalling his earlier service, the Emperor promoted him to chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 病免。

translations.literal: He was excused due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: He was excused from office due to illness.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 子瑚素通阿，初名瑚圖靈阿。

translations.literal: His son Husutong'a— originally named Hutuling'a.
translations.idiomatic: His son Husutong'a was originally named Hutuling'a.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十二年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-second year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-second year of the Qianlong reign.

sentences.zh: 由刑部員外郎改翰林院侍講，累遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: From vice director in the Board of Punishments he was transferred to Hanlin Academician Reader; he was promoted through stages to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: From vice director in the Board of Punishments he was transferred to Hanlin Academician Reader and was promoted through stages to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，疏陳關稅、鹽課積弊；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he memorialized on accumulated abuses in customs duties and salt taxes;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign he memorialized on accumulated abuses in customs duties and salt taxes;

sentences.zh: 又請卻貢獻，停捐納。

translations.literal: and also requested rejection of tribute offerings and suspension of purchase offices.
translations.idiomatic: and also requested rejection of tribute offerings and suspension of purchase offices.

sentences.zh: 居官有聲，擢盛京刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: His conduct in office had renown; he was promoted to Vice President of the Board of Punishments at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: He won a reputation in office and was promoted to Vice President of the Board of Punishments at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 宜綿遣戍，瑚素通阿以父老請代行，未允。

translations.literal: Yi Mian was sentenced to banishment; Husutong'a pleaded to go in his stead because his father was old; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi Mian was sentenced to banishment, Husutong'a asked to go in his stead because his father was old; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 在盛京，劾將軍琳寧寬縱番役及私葠、官吏分肥事，侍郎寶源查辦不實，寶源、琳寧並黜罷。

translations.literal: While at Mukden he impeached General Lin Ning for indulging native laborers and the private ginseng trade and officials dividing spoils; Vice President Bao Yuan investigated and found the charges unsubstantiated; both Bao Yuan and Lin Ning were dismissed.
