translations.idiomatic: While serving at Mukden he impeached General Lin Ning for indulging native laborers, the private ginseng trade, and officials who divided the spoils; Vice President Bao Yuan investigated and found the charges unsubstantiated, and both Bao Yuan and Lin Ning were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 內調刑部侍郎，赴河南讞獄，漏洩密封，降筆帖式。

translations.literal: Transferred inward to Vice President of the Board of Punishments; sent to hear capital cases in Henan; leaked sealed documents; demoted to clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the capital as Vice President of the Board of Punishments and sent to hear capital cases in Henan, but leaked sealed documents and was demoted to clerk.

sentences.zh: 後起用，終刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Later reemployed; ultimately ended as Vice President of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was later reemployed and ultimately ended his career as Vice President of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 英善，薩哈爾察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Yingshan, of the Saharca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan, of the Saharca clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由親軍補侍衛處筆帖式，累遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: From the imperial guard he was appointed a clerk in the Imperial Bodyguard; he was promoted through stages to director in the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: From the imperial guard he was appointed a clerk in the Imperial Bodyguard and was promoted through stages to director in the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 改御史，除甘肅蘭州道，以親老留京職。

translations.literal: Transferred to censor; appointed intendant of Lanzhou Circuit in Gansu; because his parents were old he remained in a capital post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor, appointed intendant of Lanzhou Circuit in Gansu, but because his parents were old he remained in a capital post.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，出為直隸按察使，遷湖南布政使，調江蘇，丁母憂歸。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he went out as surveillance commissioner of Zhili, was transferred to provincial treasurer of Hunan, then to Jiangsu; upon his mother's death he returned home in mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of the Qianlong reign he was posted as surveillance commissioner of Zhili, transferred to provincial treasurer of Hunan and then Jiangsu, and returned home to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 命署廣西布政使，調補四川，五十六年，護理總督。

translations.literal: Ordered to act as provincial treasurer of Guangxi; transferred to fill a post in Sichuan; in the fifty-sixth year he served as acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to act as provincial treasurer of Guangxi, transferred to fill a post in Sichuan, and in the fifty-sixth year served as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋擢貴州巡撫，調湖北，以治西藏軍需，未之任。

translations.literal: Soon promoted to governor of Guizhou; transferred to Hubei; because he was handling Tibetan military supplies he never took up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to governor of Guizhou and transferred to Hubei, but because he was handling Tibetan military supplies he never took up the post.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，調廣東。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was transferred to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign he was transferred to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 旋召授刑部侍郎，而四川教匪起，仍留攝總督。

translations.literal: Soon recalled and appointed Vice President of the Board of Punishments, but Sichuan sect rebels rose and he remained as acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled and appointed Vice President of the Board of Punishments, but when Sichuan sect rebels rose he remained as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 初，四川自金川木果木之敗，逃兵與失業夫役、無賴遊民散匿剽掠，號為啯匪。

translations.literal: Initially, since the defeat at Mugua Wood in the Jinchuan campaign, deserters, idle laborers, and rogues scattered in hiding to plunder and were called guai bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, after the defeat at Mugua Wood in the Jinchuan campaign, deserters, idle laborers, and rogues scattered in hiding to plunder and were called guai bandits.

sentences.zh: 官捕急，則入白蓮教為逋逃藪。

translations.literal: When official pursuit was fierce they entered the White Lotus sect as a refuge for fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: When official pursuit grew fierce they took refuge in the White Lotus sect.

sentences.zh: 及湖北襄陽敗匪竄入川，一旦揭竿，戰鬥如素習。

translations.literal: When defeated rebels from Xiangyang in Hubei fled into Sichuan, they raised banners at once and fought as if by long habit.
translations.idiomatic: When defeated rebels from Xiangyang in Hubei fled into Sichuan, they raised the banner at once and fought as though they had long been trained for it.

sentences.zh: 至是，達州奸民徐天德等激於胥役之虐，與太平、東鄉賊王三槐、冷天祿等並起。

translations.literal: At this point the wicked commoners of Dazhou— Xu Tiande and others— incited by the cruelty of clerks and runners, rose together with the rebels Wang Sanhuai of Taiping and Dongxiang and Leng Tianlu and others.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the wicked commoners of Dazhou— Xu Tiande and others— incited by the cruelty of clerks and runners, rose together with the rebels Wang Sanhuai of Taiping and Dongxiang and Leng Tianlu and others.

sentences.zh: 英善率兵五百馳剿，復調成都駐防兵，副都統勒禮善、佛住率以往，連破賊巢，擒賊目何三元等。

translations.literal: Yingshan led five hundred troops in rapid suppression, also mobilized the Chengdu garrison, and Lieutenant General Lelishan and Fozhu led them forward; they stormed rebel lairs in succession and captured the rebel chieftain He Sanyuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan led five hundred troops in rapid suppression, also mobilized the Chengdu garrison, and Lieutenant General Lelishan and Fozhu led them forward; they stormed rebel lairs in succession and captured the rebel chieftain He Sanyuan and others.

sentences.zh: 賊竄橫山子，據險負嵎，遣總兵袁國璜、何元卿分路進攻，戰三日，國璜、元卿並歿於陣。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Hengshanzi, holding rugged terrain in stubborn defense; he dispatched Major Yuan Guohuang and He Yuanqing to attack by separate routes; after three days of battle both Guohuang and Yuanqing died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Hengshanzi and held rugged terrain in stubborn defense; he dispatched Major Yuan Guohuang and He Yuanqing to attack by separate routes, and after three days of battle both Guohuang and Yuanqing died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 尋克馬鞍山賊寨，擒賊首徐天富；

translations.literal: Soon they stormed the rebel stockade at Ma'anshan and captured the rebel leader Xu Tianfu;
translations.idiomatic: Soon they stormed the rebel stockade at Ma'anshan and captured the rebel leader Xu Tianfu;

sentences.zh: 而王三槐、徐天德等合陷東鄉，佛住戰死，賊熾兵單，詔責英善固守毋輕進，命宜綿赴達州督師。

translations.literal: But Wang Sanhuai, Xu Tiande, and others together overran Dongxiang; Fozhu died in battle; the rebels were fierce and his troops few; an edict rebuked Yingshan to hold firm and not advance rashly, and ordered Yi Mian to Dazhou to supervise the army.
translations.idiomatic: But Wang Sanhuai, Xu Tiande, and others together overran Dongxiang; Fozhu died in battle; the rebels were fierce and his troops were few; an edict rebuked Yingshan to hold firm and not advance rashly, and ordered Yi Mian to Dazhou to supervise the army.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，宜綿至，英善連破賊於貫子山、羅江口，通周家河運路；

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year Yi Mian arrived; Yingshan repeatedly defeated the rebels at Guanzishan and Luojiang Mouth and opened the Zhoujia River supply route;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year Yi Mian arrived; Yingshan repeatedly defeated the rebels at Guanzishan and Luojiang Mouth and opened the Zhoujia River supply route;

sentences.zh: 偕宜綿克張家觀，復東鄉。

translations.literal: Together with Yi Mian he stormed Zhangjia Temple and recovered Dongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Yi Mian he stormed Zhangjia Temple and recovered Dongxiang.

sentences.zh: 五月，命赴甘肅攝總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was ordered to go to Gansu as acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was ordered to go to Gansu as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 王三槐等由通江、巴州分犯保寧，英善赴廣元迎剿，偕總兵富爾賽、硃射鬥擊之於儀隴、閬中，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: Wang Sanhuai and others from Tongjiang and Bazhou separately invaded Baoning; Yingshan went to Guangyuan to meet and suppress them; together with Majors Fuersai and Zhu Shedou he struck them at Yilong and Langzhong, killing and capturing many.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sanhuai and others from Tongjiang and Bazhou separately invaded Baoning; Yingshan went to Guangyuan to meet and suppress them, and together with Majors Fuersai and Zhu Shedou struck them at Yilong and Langzhong, killing and capturing many.

sentences.zh: 賊逼蒼溪，設伏敗之，遂遁。

translations.literal: The rebels pressed on Cangxi; he set an ambush and defeated them, and they fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels pressed on Cangxi, he set an ambush and defeated them, and they fled.

sentences.zh: 三年，命與福寧赴達州治四川糧運。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered with Funing to go to Dazhou to manage Sichuan grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was ordered to go with Funing to Dazhou to manage Sichuan grain transport.

sentences.zh: 四年，調兵部侍郎，充駐藏大臣，調吏部，駐藏如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year transferred to Vice President of the Board of War, appointed Resident Minister in Tibet; transferred to the Board of Civil Office while remaining stationed in Tibet as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to Vice President of the Board of War and appointed Resident Minister in Tibet; he was then transferred to the Board of Civil Office while remaining stationed in Tibet as before.

sentences.zh: 五年，帝以教匪久未平，追論始事諸臣玩寇罪，褫職，以四品頂戴仍留駐藏。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because the sect rebels had long gone unpacified, the Emperor reviewed retrospectively the crime of indulging the enemy among the officials who first handled the matter; Yingshan was stripped of office but kept in Tibet with a fourth-rank button.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, because the sect rebels had long gone unpacified, the Emperor reviewed retrospectively the crime of indulging the enemy among the officials who first handled the matter; Yingshan was stripped of office but kept in Tibet with a fourth-rank button.

sentences.zh: 七年，召授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the seventh year recalled and appointed a first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was recalled and appointed a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 擢刑部侍郎，遷左都御史，兼正黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Promoted to Vice President of the Board of Punishments; transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; concurrently commander of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice President of the Board of Punishments, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief, and concurrently appointed commander of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以駐藏時於福寧私挪庫款，徇隱未舉，降太常​​寺卿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because while stationed in Tibet he had privately diverted treasury funds for Funing and concealed the matter without reporting it, he was demoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, because while stationed in Tibet he had privately diverted treasury funds for Funing and concealed the matter without reporting it, he was demoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 福寧，伊爾根覺羅氏。

translations.literal: Funing, of the Irgen Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: Funing was of the Irgen Gioro clan.

sentences.zh: 初隸貝子永固包衣。

translations.literal: At first he belonged to the household servants of Prince Yonggu.
translations.idiomatic: At first he belonged to the household servants of Prince Yonggu.

sentences.zh: 由兵部筆帖式洊擢工部郎中。

translations.literal: From a clerk in the Board of War he was promoted in succession to director in the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: From a clerk in the Board of War he was promoted in succession to director in the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十三年，出為甘肅平慶道，累遷陝西布政使。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Qianlong he went out as intendant of the Pingqing Circuit in Gansu and was promoted through stages to provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year of the Qianlong reign he was posted as intendant of the Pingqing Circuit in Gansu and was promoted through stages to provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，擢湖北巡撫，抬入鑲藍旗滿洲。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year promoted to governor of Hubei and enrolled in the Bordered Blue Banner Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei and enrolled in the Bordered Blue Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 調山東，治衛河運務，稱旨。

translations.literal: Transferred to Shandong; managed Wei River transport duties; won imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Shandong, he managed Wei River transport duties and won imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，漳、衛二河溢，疏消積水，撫卹災黎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the Zhang and Wei rivers overflowed; he dredged and drained accumulated floodwater and comforted the disaster-stricken populace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year the Zhang and Wei rivers overflowed; he dredged and drained the accumulated floodwater and comforted the disaster-stricken populace.

sentences.zh: 曹、單漫水，下流為豐、碭壩堰所阻，馳往會勘，酌開壩堰以洩水，並協機宜。

translations.literal: Cao and Shan were inundated; downstream the flood was blocked by barrages at Feng and Dang; he hurried to meet in joint survey, decided to open the barrages to release water, and coordinated plans accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao and Shan were inundated and downstream the flood was blocked by barrages at Feng and Dang, he hurried to meet in joint survey, decided to open the barrages to release water, and coordinated plans accordingly.

sentences.zh: 調河南，尋擢湖廣總督，駐襄陽，捕治教匪，獲首逆宋之清等寘諸法。

translations.literal: Transferred to Henan; soon promoted to governor-general of Huguang, stationed at Xiangyang; captured and punished sect rebels, seized the chief rebel Song Zhiqing and others and put them to the law.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Henan, he was soon promoted to governor-general of Huguang and stationed at Xiangyang, where he captured and punished sect rebels, seized the chief rebel Song Zhiqing and others, and put them to the law.

sentences.zh: 六十年，調兩江。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year transferred to the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was transferred to the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 會黔苗石柳鄧勾結楚苗石三保焚掠辰州，命留湖北會剿，福寧至鎮筸防後路。

translations.literal: When Guizhou Miao Shiliudeng colluded with Hunan Miao Shi Sanbao to burn and plunder Chenzhou, he was ordered to remain in Hubei for joint suppression; Funing went to Zhenxiong to guard the rear.
translations.idiomatic: When Guizhou Miao Shiliudeng colluded with Hunan Miao Shi Sanbao to burn and plunder Chenzhou, he was ordered to remain in Hubei for joint suppression, and Funing went to Zhenxiong to guard the rear.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，湖北教匪攻來鳳甚急，福寧馳抵龍山，擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, Hubei sect rebels attacked Laifeng with great urgency; Funing hurried to Longshan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign, Hubei sect rebels attacked Laifeng with great urgency; Funing hurried to Longshan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊屯旗鼓寨，偕四川總督孫士毅合剿，士毅卒於軍，福寧代之。

translations.literal: The rebels encamped at Qibozhai; together with Sichuan Governor-General Sun Shiyi he jointly suppressed them; Shiyi died in the army and Funing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels encamped at Qibozhai; together with Sichuan Governor-General Sun Shiyi he jointly suppressed them, but Shiyi died in the army and Funing replaced him.

sentences.zh: 偕將軍觀成、總兵諸神保進攻，破其寨，擒賊首胡正中，餘眾窮促乞降，誘入龍山城，駢誅二千餘人，以臨陣殲戮奏，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Together with General Guancheng and Major Zhushenbao he advanced, stormed their stockade, and captured the rebel leader Hu Zhengzhong; the remainder, pressed to desperation, begged to surrender; they were lured into Longshan City and more than two thousand were executed in batches; reporting this as annihilation on the battlefield, he was awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Together with General Guancheng and Major Zhushenbao he advanced and stormed their stockade, capturing the rebel leader Hu Zhengzhong; the remainder, pressed to desperation, begged to surrender and were lured into Longshan City, where more than two thousand were executed in batches; reporting this as annihilation on the battlefield, he was awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 移軍剿林之華、覃加耀於長陽、巴東，賊竄黃柏山；

translations.literal: He shifted troops to suppress Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao at Changyang and Badong; the rebels fled to Huangbai Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: He shifted troops to suppress Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao at Changyang and Badong, but the rebels fled to Huangbai Mountain;

sentences.zh: 偕觀成、惠齡會剿未下，惠齡赴襄陽，觀成入川。

translations.literal: Together with Guancheng and Huiling he jointly campaigned but did not finish; Huiling went to Xiangyang and Guancheng entered Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Guancheng and Huiling he jointly campaigned but did not finish; Huiling went to Xiangyang and Guancheng entered Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二年，命額勒登保移師黃柏山，福寧以兵隸之。

translations.literal: In the second year Eledengbao was ordered to shift troops to Huangbai Mountain; Funing's troops were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Eledengbao was ordered to shift troops to Huangbai Mountain, and Funing's troops were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 地形天險，圍攻數月，賊竄鶴峰芭葉山，繼竄大拏口，又竄建始、宣恩；

translations.literal: The terrain was naturally perilous; they besieged for months; the rebels fled to Baye Mountain in Hefeng, then to Dana Pass, then again to Jianshi and Xuan'en;
translations.idiomatic: The terrain was naturally perilous; they besieged for months, but the rebels fled to Baye Mountain in Hefeng, then to Dana Pass, and then again to Jianshi and Xuan'en;

sentences.zh: 十一月，始殲之華於長陽，加耀遁歸州，以勦賊不力，奪宮銜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Zhihua was finally killed at Changyang; Jiayao fled to Guizhou; for ineffective suppression his court rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhihua was finally killed at Changyang, but Jiayao fled to Guizhou; for ineffective suppression his court rank was stripped.

sentences.zh: 三年，擒加耀於終報寨，帝猶斥諸將遷延貽誤，福寧有地方之責，咎尤重，褫職，罰銀四萬兩充餉；

translations.literal: In the third year Jiayao was captured at Zhongbao Stockade; the Emperor still rebuked the generals for delay and error; Funing bore local responsibility and his blame was especially heavy; he was stripped of office and fined forty thousand taels of silver for military rations;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Jiayao was captured at Zhongbao Stockade, but the Emperor still rebuked the generals for delay and error; Funing bore local responsibility and his blame was especially heavy, so he was stripped of office and fined forty thousand taels of silver for military rations;

sentences.zh: 予副都統銜，偕英善駐達州，治四川軍需。

translations.literal: Granted the rank of Lieutenant General; together with Yingshan he was stationed at Dazhou to manage Sichuan military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Granted the rank of Lieutenant General, he was stationed at Dazhou together with Yingshan to manage Sichuan military supplies.

sentences.zh: 四年，英善調駐西藏，福寧遂專任其事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Yingshan was transferred to station in Tibet; Funing then solely undertook the duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Yingshan was transferred to station in Tibet, and Funing then solely undertook the duty.

sentences.zh: 時軍營支用冒濫，統兵大員奢糜無度，兵勇口糧反多遲延，幾致枵腹，四川餉數更多於湖北數倍，屢詔訓戒，福寧不能綜覈，以奏報浮泛被詰。

translations.literal: At the time military camp expenditures were extravagantly inflated; commanders were prodigal without limit; soldiers' rations were often delayed, nearly leaving them starving; Sichuan's supplies were many times greater than Hubei's; repeated edicts admonished; Funing could not thoroughly audit; his memorials were vague and he was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: At the time military camp expenditures were extravagantly inflated, commanders were prodigal without limit, and soldiers' rations were often delayed, nearly leaving them starving; Sichuan's supplies were many times greater than Hubei's; despite repeated edicts of admonishment Funing could not thoroughly audit affairs, and his vague memorials drew rebuke.

sentences.zh: 又奏賊數有增無減，勒保疏辨；

translations.literal: He also memorialized that rebel numbers were increasing rather than decreasing; Le Bao memorialized in rebuttal;
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that rebel numbers were increasing rather than decreasing, and Le Bao memorialized in rebuttal;

sentences.zh: 命魁倫赴達州察視，覆陳賊數實減，而大股分為小股，賊名反多，得福寧理餉含混狀，詔褫副都統銜，留達州候命。

translations.literal: Kuilun was ordered to Dazhou to inspect; he reported again that rebel numbers had in fact decreased, but large bands had split into small bands so rebel names were actually more numerous; finding Funing's handling of supplies muddled, an edict stripped his Lieutenant General rank and he remained at Dazhou awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun was ordered to Dazhou to inspect and reported again that rebel numbers had in fact decreased, but because large bands had split into small bands rebel names were actually more numerous; finding Funing's handling of supplies muddled, an edict stripped his Lieutenant General rank and he remained at Dazhou awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 尋以旗鼓寨殺降事覺，帝​​方以剿撫責諸路，而川賊高均德被擒，言賊黨恐投降仍遭誅戮，故多觀望。

translations.literal: Soon the Qibozhai massacre of those who surrendered came to light; the Emperor was then charging all routes with both suppression and pacification; the Sichuan rebel Gao Junde was captured and said the rebel factions feared that if they surrendered they would still be executed, so many held back and watched.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Qibozhai massacre of those who surrendered came to light; the Emperor was then charging all routes with both suppression and pacification, and the captured Sichuan rebel Gao Junde said the rebel factions feared that if they surrendered they would still be executed, so many held back and watched.

sentences.zh: 詔斥福寧此舉失人心而傷天理，逮治論罪，遣戍新疆，尋原之，命赴額勒登保軍前效力。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Funing's act as losing hearts and violating heaven's principle; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced, and banished to Xinjiang; soon he was pardoned and ordered to serve at the front under Eledengbao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Funing's act as losing hearts and violating heaven's principle; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced and banished to Xinjiang, but was soon pardoned and ordered to serve at the front under Eledengbao.

sentences.zh: 會賊竄渡嘉陵江，由於福寧裁撤鄉勇所致，仍戍伊犁。

translations.literal: When rebels fled and crossed the Jialing River— because Funing had disbanded local militia— he was again exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels fled and crossed the Jialing River— because Funing had disbanded the local militia— he was again exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 五年，予三等侍衛，赴西藏辦事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year granted a third-class bodyguard post; sent to Tibet on official business.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was granted a third-class bodyguard post and sent to Tibet on official business.

sentences.zh: 九年，召還，授正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the ninth year recalled and appointed commander of the Plain White Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was recalled and appointed commander of the Plain White Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以三品銜休致。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year retired with third-rank status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he retired with third-rank status.

sentences.zh: 十九年，追論在西藏擅借庫帑，及湖廣任內濫用軍需，久不完繳，下獄。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year reviewed retrospectively for borrowing from the treasury without authorization in Tibet and for misuse of military supplies during his Huguang tenure without long completing repayment; imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was reviewed retrospectively for borrowing from the treasury without authorization in Tibet and for misuse of military supplies during his Huguang tenure without long completing repayment, and was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died.

sentences.zh: 景安，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，和珅族孫也。

translations.literal: Jing'an, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and a clan grandson of Heshen.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered Red Banner and a clan grandson of Heshen.

sentences.zh: 由官學生授內閣中書，洊擢戶部郎中。

translations.literal: From an Imperial Academy student he was appointed a secretary of the Grand Secretariat and was promoted in succession to director in the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: From an Imperial Academy student he was appointed a secretary of the Grand Secretariat and was promoted in succession to director in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 出為山西河東道，累遷甘肅、河南按察使，河南、山西、甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: He went out as intendant of the Hedong Circuit in Shanxi and was promoted through stages to surveillance commissioner of Gansu and Henan and provincial treasurer of Henan, Shanxi, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as intendant of the Hedong Circuit in Shanxi and was promoted through stages to surveillance commissioner of Gansu and Henan and provincial treasurer of Henan, Shanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十六年，徵廓爾喀，命治西寧至藏台站，留藏督餉運。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year of Qianlong, during the campaign against Gorkha, he was ordered to manage relay stations from Xining to Tibet and remained in Tibet supervising supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, during the campaign against Gorkha, he was ordered to manage relay stations from Xining to Tibet and remained in Tibet supervising supply transport.

sentences.zh: 事平，以親老歸。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled he returned home because his parents were old.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were settled he returned home because his parents were old.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢工部侍郎，歷倉場、戶部。

translations.literal: Before long promoted to Vice President of the Board of Works and successively served in the Granary Administration and the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Vice President of the Board of Works and successively served in the Granary Administration and the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 六十年，授河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year appointed governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was appointed governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，湖北教匪北犯，景安駐軍南陽，以籌濟恆瑞軍餉，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, Hubei sect rebels invaded northward; Jing'an stationed troops at Nanyang to provision Hengrui's army and was awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign, Hubei sect rebels invaded northward; Jing'an stationed troops at Nanyang to provision Hengrui's army and was awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二月，姚之富犯鄧州，圍景安於魏家集，恆瑞援至始解。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Yao Zhifu attacked Dengzhou and besieged Jing'an at Weijiaji; the siege was lifted only when Hengrui's relief arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yao Zhifu attacked Dengzhou and besieged Jing'an at Weijiaji; the siege was lifted only when Hengrui's relief arrived.

sentences.zh: 二年，淅川教匪王佐臣謀應賊，布政使完顏岱捕斬之。

translations.literal: In the second year the Xichuan sect rebel Wang Zuochen plotted to respond to the rebels; Provincial Treasurer Wanyan Dai captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Xichuan sect rebel Wang Zuochen plotted to respond to the rebels, and Provincial Treasurer Wanyan Dai captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 景安欲攘功，躡兵戮難民，以捷聞，賞雙眼花翎，封三等伯。

translations.literal: Jing'an wished to seize credit; he sent troops after fleeing refugees and slaughtered them, reporting victory; he was awarded double-eyed peacock feathers and enfeoffed as a third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an wished to seize credit for himself; he sent troops after fleeing refugees and slaughtered them, reported victory, and was awarded double-eyed peacock feathers and enfeoffed as a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 時襄陽賊屢為惠齡、慶成等所破，窺北面可乘，遂分三路犯河南：王廷詔出北路，竄葉縣，焚保安驛，圍官軍於裕州，總兵王文雄兵至，乃引去，景安尾追至南召，聞桐柏有警，馳回防禦；

translations.literal: At that time the Xiangyang rebels, repeatedly defeated by Huiling, Qingcheng, and others, saw an opening to the north and divided into three routes to invade Henan: Wang Tingzhao took the northern route, fled into Yexian, burned Bao'an Post, and besieged the government army at Yuzhou; when Major Wang Wenxiong's troops arrived they withdrew; Jing'an pursued to Nanzhao, but hearing of an alarm at Tongbai he hurried back to defend;
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Xiangyang rebels, repeatedly defeated by Huiling, Qingcheng, and others, saw an opening to the north and divided into three routes to invade Henan: Wang Tingzhao took the northern route, fled into Yexian, burned Bao'an Post, and besieged the government army at Yuzhou; when Major Wang Wenxiong's troops arrived they withdrew, and Jing'an pursued to Nanzhao, but hearing of an alarm at Tongbai he hurried back to defend;

sentences.zh: 李全出西路，竄信陽、確山，羅山、淅川，趨盧氏，出武關，慶成追之；

translations.literal: Li Quan took the western route, fled through Xinyang, Queshan, Luoshan, and Xichuan, pressed toward Lushi, and exited Wuguan; Qingcheng pursued him;
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan took the western route, fled through Xinyang, Queshan, Luoshan, and Xichuan, pressed toward Lushi, and exited Wuguan, while Qingcheng pursued him;

sentences.zh: 姚之富、齊王氏出中路，竄南陽，掠嵩縣、山陽，惠齡追之。

translations.literal: Yao Zhifu and Qi Wangshi took the central route, fled into Nanyang, and plundered Song County and Shanyang; Huiling pursued them.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zhifu and Qi Wangshi took the central route, fled into Nanyang, plundered Song County and Shanyang, and Huiling pursued them.

sentences.zh: 賊入河南後，虜脅日眾，不迎戰，不走平原，忽合忽分，以牽兵勢，先後併入陝西復合。

translations.literal: After entering Henan the rebels' captives and followers grew daily; they did not offer battle, avoided open plains, suddenly merging and separating to draw off government forces, and successively entered Shaanxi and merged again.
translations.idiomatic: After entering Henan the rebels' captives and followers grew daily; they refused battle, avoided open plains, suddenly merged and separated to draw off government forces, and successively entered Shaanxi and merged again.

sentences.zh: 景安頓兵內鄉，賊入陝後二十餘日，始追至盧氏，賊尤輕之，號為「迎送伯」。

translations.literal: Jing'an halted his army at Neixiang; more than twenty days after the rebels entered Shaanxi he finally pursued to Lushi; the rebels especially despised him and called him the Escort Baron.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an halted his army at Neixiang, and more than twenty days after the rebels entered Shaanxi he finally pursued to Lushi; the rebels especially despised him and called him the Escort Baron.

sentences.zh: 三年春，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 四月，率師次荊門州，劉成棟來犯，與布政使高杞分路擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he led troops and encamped at Jingmen Prefecture; Liu Chengdong came to attack; together with Provincial Treasurer Gao Qi he drove the rebels off by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he led troops and encamped at Jingmen Prefecture; when Liu Chengdong came to attack, he and Provincial Treasurer Gao Qi drove the rebels off by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 六月，賊由竹谿竄入陝，詔切責。

translations.literal: In the sixth month rebels fled from Zhuxi into Shaanxi; an edict sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month rebels fled from Zhuxi into Shaanxi, and an edict sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 四年，張漢潮擾陝西五郎、洋縣，景安屯鄖陽，遣總兵王凱扼鄖西。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhang Hanchao harassed Wulang and Yang County in Shaanxi; Jing'an encamped at Yunyang and dispatched Major Wang Kai to block Yunxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zhang Hanchao harassed Wulang and Yang County in Shaanxi; Jing'an encamped at Yunyang and dispatched Major Wang Kai to block Yunxi.

sentences.zh: 漢潮已分路自安康折竄鎮安，景安疏稱赴鄖西迎剿，詔斥其不實。

translations.literal: Hanchao had already split routes and turned from Ankang to flee toward Zhen'an; Jing'an memorialized that he was going to Yunxi to meet and suppress them; an edict rebuked this as untrue.
translations.idiomatic: Hanchao had already split routes and turned from Ankang to flee toward Zhen'an, but Jing'an memorialized that he was going to Yunxi to meet and suppress them; an edict rebuked this as untrue.

sentences.zh: 時仁宗初親政，以景安堵剿不力，撫治失當，解職，命治四川軍需。

translations.literal: When the Emperor Renzong first personally took power, Jing'an was removed from office for ineffective blocking and suppression and improper pacification, and ordered to manage Sichuan military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor Renzong first personally took power, Jing'an was removed from office for ineffective blocking and suppression and improper pacification, and ordered to manage Sichuan military supplies.

sentences.zh: 尋奪伯爵，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Soon his barony was revoked and he was exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his barony was revoked and he was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，帝召見惠齡，論其恇怯縱寇及淅川冒功事，逮京讞，擬大辟，緩刑，禁錮。

translations.literal: That winter the Emperor summoned Huiling and discussed his cowardice in letting rebels escape and the Xichuan false credit affair; Jing'an was brought to the capital for trial, sentenced to death, commuted, and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Emperor summoned Huiling and discussed his cowardice in letting rebels escape and the Xichuan false credit affair; Jing'an was brought to the capital for trial, sentenced to death, commuted, and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 七年，教匪平，得釋，發熱河充披甲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the sect rebels were pacified, he was released and sent to Rehe to serve as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the sect rebels were pacified, he was released and sent to Rehe to serve as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 逾年，宥還，以六部筆帖式用，效力河南河工。

translations.literal: The next year pardoned and returned; employed as a clerk in one of the Six Boards; served on Henan river works.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was pardoned and returned, employed as a clerk in one of the Six Boards, and sent to serve on Henan river works.

sentences.zh: 衡家樓工竣，晉秩員外郎，授直隸承德知府。

translations.literal: When the Hengjialou project was completed, promoted to vice director rank and appointed prefect of Chengde in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hengjialou project was completed, he was promoted to vice director rank and appointed prefect of Chengde in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 擢山西按察使、陝西布政使。

translations.literal: Promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shanxi and provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shanxi and provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授江西巡撫，調湖南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year appointed governor of Jiangxi; transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed governor of Jiangxi and transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 召為內閣學士，累遷戶部尚書，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Recalled as a Grand Secretariat academician; promoted through stages to Minister of the Board of Revenue; awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as a Grand Secretariat academician, promoted through stages to Minister of the Board of Revenue, and awarded Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授領侍衛內大臣，守護昌陵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year appointed Chief Guard of the Palace Guards and charged with guarding Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed Chief Guard of the Palace Guards and charged with guarding Changling.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，休致。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he retired.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died.

sentences.zh: 景安初附和珅，懵於軍事，然居官廉。

translations.literal: Jing'an had at first attached himself to Heshen; he was ignorant of military affairs, yet in office he was incorrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an had at first attached himself to Heshen; he was ignorant of military affairs, yet in office he was incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 當其逮京，值硃珪入見，帝曰：「景安至矣！

translations.literal: When he was arrested and brought to the capital, Zhu Gui happened to be received in audience; the emperor said: "Jing'an has arrived!
translations.idiomatic: When he was brought to the capital under arrest, Zhu Gui happened to be received in audience. The emperor said, "Jing'an has arrived!

sentences.zh: 軍事久不定，欲去一人以警眾，如何？」

translations.literal: The military situation has long been unsettled; I wish to remove one man to warn the multitude—what do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: The war has dragged on without resolution. I mean to make an example of one man to warn the rest. What do you think?"

sentences.zh: 珪曰：「臣聞景安不要錢。」

translations.literal: Zhu Gui said: "Your servant has heard that Jing'an does not take money."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Gui replied, "I have heard that Jing'an does not take bribes."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「若乃知操守耶？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "So you know about integrity, do you?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "So you do know something about integrity after all?"

sentences.zh: 竟以是獲免。

translations.literal: In the end he was spared on this account.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he was spared on that account.

sentences.zh: 後復用之。

translations.literal: Later he was again employed.
translations.idiomatic: He was later restored to office.

sentences.zh: 秦承恩，字芝軒，江蘇江寧人。

translations.literal: Qin Chen'en, style Zhixuan, was a native of Jiangning in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Chen'en, style name Zhixuan, was a native of Jiangning in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，擢侍講。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twenty-sixth year of Qianlong, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed a compiler, and promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 出為江西廣饒九南道，累遷直隸布政使。

translations.literal: He went out as intendant of the Guangrao-Jiunan Circuit in Jiangxi and was promoted through stages to provincial treasurer of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as intendant of the Guangrao-Jiunan Circuit in Jiangxi and rose through stages to provincial treasurer of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，擢陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，教匪起荊、襄，承恩率師赴興安籌防。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing sect rebels rose in Jing and Xiang; Chen'en led troops to Xing'an to organize defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing, sect rebels broke out in Jingzhou and Xiangyang; Chen'en led troops to Xing'an to organize the defense.

sentences.zh: 至冬，四川達州教匪自太平入陝犯興安，承恩偕總督宜綿迭擊敗之。

translations.literal: By winter the Dazhou sect rebels of Sichuan entered Shaanxi from Taiping and struck Xing'an; Chen'en with Governor-General Yi Mian repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: By winter the Dazhou sect rebels of Sichuan entered Shaanxi from Taiping and attacked Xing'an; Chen'en and Governor-General Yi Mian defeated them in successive engagements.

sentences.zh: 十二月，會剿洞河、汝河諸賊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he joined in suppressing the rebels along the Dong and Ru rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he joined the campaign against rebels along the Dong and Ru rivers.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，擊安康賊於光頭山，首逆王劉氏伏誅，陝境略平。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year he attacked the Ankang rebels at Guangtou Mountain; the chief rebel Wang Liushi was executed, and Shaanxi territory was largely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year he attacked the Ankang rebels at Guangtou Mountain; the chief rebel Wang Liushi was executed, and Shaanxi was largely pacified.

sentences.zh: 宜綿進剿川匪，承恩專任陝防。

translations.literal: Yi Mian advanced to suppress Sichuan bandits, and Chen'en was solely responsible for Shaanxi defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian advanced into Sichuan to suppress the rebels, while Chen'en was left in sole charge of Shaanxi's defense.

sentences.zh: 三月，襄匪由河南盧氏竄商南，勾結陝匪，紛起應之。

translations.literal: In the third month Xiangyang bandits fled from Lushi in Henan to Shangnan, incited Shaanxi bandits, and many rose in response.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Xiangyang rebels fled from Lushi in Henan to Shangnan, stirred up Shaanxi rebels, and uprisings broke out in response across the region.

sentences.zh: 承恩移軍商州，偕恆瑞殲山陽西牛槽賊。

translations.literal: Chen'en moved his army to Shangzhou and with Hengrui destroyed the rebels at Xiniucao west of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen'en moved his army to Shangzhou and, together with Hengrui, wiped out the rebels at Xiniucao west of Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 雒南石板溝奸民起，總兵富爾賽捕斬之。

translations.literal: Wicked commoners rose at Shibangou in Luonan; Major Fuersai captured and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Disaffected locals rose at Shibangou in Luonan; Major Fuersai captured and executed them.

sentences.zh: 姚之富由商州犯孝義，窺西安，承恩扼之於秦嶺。

translations.literal: Yao Zhifu from Shangzhou struck Xiaoyi and eyed Xi'an; Chen'en blocked him at the Qin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zhifu advanced from Shangzhou against Xiaoyi and threatened Xi'an; Chen'en blocked him at the Qin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 惠齡等追擊，賊走鎮安，與李全、王廷詔合掠洵陽、安康。

translations.literal: Huiling and others pursued; the rebels fled to Zhen'an, joined Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao, and together ravaged Xunyang and Ankang.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling and others pursued; the rebels fled to Zhen'an, joined Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao, and together raided Xunyang and Ankang.

sentences.zh: 時陝西兵力僅有鄉勇萬餘人，提督柯籓守興安府城，兵止二百，無力攻剿。

translations.literal: At this time Shaanxi had only a little over ten thousand militia; Provincial Military Commissioner Ke Fan guarded the Xing'an prefectural city with only two hundred troops and lacked strength to attack.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shaanxi had only a little over ten thousand militiamen; Provincial Military Commissioner Ke Fan held the Xing'an prefectural seat with just two hundred troops and lacked the strength to take the offensive.

sentences.zh: 惠齡、恆瑞合擊賊於黃龍鋪，賊分竄復合，六月，由漢陰至紫陽渡漢江。

translations.literal: Huiling and Hengrui jointly struck the rebels at Huanglongpu; the rebels scattered and merged again; in the sixth month they crossed the Han River from Hanyin to Ziyang.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling and Hengrui attacked the rebels together at Huanglongpu; the rebels scattered and regrouped, and in the sixth month they crossed the Han River from Hanyin to Ziyang.

sentences.zh: 詔斥承恩疏防，奪翎頂。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Chen'en for lax defense and stripped his peacock feathers and rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Chen'en for lax defense and stripped him of his peacock feathers and rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 賊走漢南，與川匪合，八月，復入陝，竄白河石槽溝。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to southern Han territory, joined Sichuan bandits, and in the eighth month again entered Shaanxi, fleeing to Shicaogou in Baihe.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to southern Han territory, joined forces with Sichuan bandits, and in the eighth month re-entered Shaanxi, taking refuge at Shicaogou in Baihe.

sentences.zh: 承恩率鄉勇扼安康要隘，賊分路來犯，御之於平利金堂寺。

translations.literal: Chen'en led militia to hold the vital passes of Ankang; the rebels came by separate routes, and he met them at Jintang Temple in Pingli.
translations.idiomatic: Chen'en led militia to hold the vital passes around Ankang; when the rebels attacked along several routes, he met them at Jintang Temple in Pingli.

sentences.zh: 既而賊逼興安，偕惠齡擊走之，以功复翎頂。

translations.literal: Soon the rebels pressed Xing'an; together with Huiling he drove them off, and for this merit his peacock feathers and insignia were restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels soon threatened Xing'an, he joined Huiling in driving them off and had his peacock feathers and insignia restored for the achievement.

sentences.zh: 三年春，丁母憂，軍事方亟，奪情視事。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he was in mourning for his mother; military affairs were urgent, and he was ordered to remain on duty despite mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he entered mourning for his mother; because military affairs were urgent, he was ordered to remain on duty despite his bereavement.

sentences.zh: 二月，高均德、齊王氏合竄漢陰觀音河，糾李全，王廷詔分道由城固、南鄭北出寶雞，合攻郿縣，掠盩厔，將犯西安，承恩恇懼，率師回防。

translations.literal: In the second month Gao Junde and Qi Wangshi together fled to Guanyin River in Hanyin, rallied Li Quan, and Wang Tingzhao split forces from Chenggu and Nanzheng north to Baoji, jointly attacked Mei County, plundered Zhouzhi, and were about to strike Xi'an; Chen'en was fearful and led his army back to defend.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Gao Junde and Qi Wangshi fled together to Guanyin River in Hanyin, rallied Li Quan, and sent Wang Tingzhao by separate routes from Chenggu and Nanzheng north toward Baoji; they jointly attacked Mei County, plundered Zhouzhi, and were about to threaten Xi'an. Chen'en, alarmed, led his army back to defend the capital region.

sentences.zh: 總兵王文雄力戰，敗賊於焦家鎮、圪子村，大創之，賊復分竄。

translations.literal: Major Wang Wenxiong fought fiercely, defeated the rebels at Jiaojiazhen and Gezicun, inflicted heavy losses, and the rebels again scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Major Wang Wenxiong fought fiercely and defeated the rebels at Jiaojiazhen and Gezicun, inflicting heavy losses; the rebels scattered again.

sentences.zh: 三月，文雄复破李全餘眾於翔峪、澧峪。

translations.literal: In the third month Wenxiong again defeated Li Quan's remaining followers at Xiangyu and Liyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Wenxiong again defeated the remnants of Li Quan's force at Xiangyu and Liyu.

sentences.zh: 四月，李全糾阮正通折回鎮安，西擾漢陰、石泉，高均德逾秦嶺走老林，承恩與文雄扼子午峪。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Li Quan rallied Ruan Zhengtong to turn back to Zhen'an and harass Hanyin and Shiquan to the west; Gao Junde crossed the Qin Mountains into the deep forests; Chen'en with Wenxiong blocked Ziwu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Quan rallied Ruan Zhengtong, turned back toward Zhen'an, and raided west into Hanyin and Shiquan; Gao Junde crossed the Qin Mountains into the deep forests; Chen'en and Wenxiong blocked Ziwu Valley.

sentences.zh: 既而均​​德、全與張天倫合為一路，正通由石泉、洋縣西竄，均德等尋竄入川。

translations.literal: Soon Junde, Quan, and Zhang Tianlun merged into one column; Zhengtong fled west through Shiquan and Yang County, and Junde and the others soon fled into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Junde, Quan, and Zhang Tianlun merged into one force; Zhengtong fled west through Shiquan and Yang County, and Junde and the others soon crossed into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 承恩進兵漢中。

translations.literal: Chen'en advanced his army into Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Chen'en advanced into Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 八月，川匪徐天德、冉文儔、樊人傑，襄匪張漢潮先後併入陝境。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Sichuan bandits Xu Tiande, Ran Wenfu, and Fan Renjie and the Xiangyang bandit Zhang Hanchao successively entered Shaanxi territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Sichuan rebels Xu Tiande, Ran Wenfu, and Fan Renjie and the Xiangyang rebel Zhang Hanchao successively poured into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 承恩師久無功，四年，命解職回籍守制。

translations.literal: Chen'en's army had long achieved nothing; in the fourth year he was ordered to resign and return home to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Chen'en's army had long failed to achieve results; in the fourth year he was ordered to resign and return home to complete his mourning obligations.

sentences.zh: 會剿張漢潮於鳳翔，承恩遣游擊蘇維龍扼東路，戰失利，漢潮突圍遁；

translations.literal: He joined in suppressing Zhang Hanchao at Fengxiang; Chen'en sent Colonel Su Weilong to block the eastern route, but the battle failed and Hanchao broke out and escaped;
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Zhang Hanchao at Fengxiang; Chen'en sent Colonel Su Weilong to block the eastern route, but the battle failed and Hanchao broke through and escaped;

sentences.zh: 褫承恩職，逮京論大辟。

translations.literal: Chen'en was stripped of office, arrested, brought to the capital, and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Chen'en was stripped of office, arrested, brought to the capital, and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 詔以承恩書生，未嫺軍事，宥歸。

translations.literal: An edict held that Chen'en was a scholar unskilled in military affairs and pardoned him to return home.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that Chen'en was a scholar unversed in military affairs and pardoned him to return home.

sentences.zh: 尋遣戍伊犁，七年，釋還。

translations.literal: Soon he was banished to serve at Yili; in the seventh year he was released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon banished to Yili; in the seventh year he was released and allowed to return.

sentences.zh: 起主事，纂修會典。

translations.literal: He was reappointed as a director and helped compile the Collected Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He was reappointed as a director and helped compile the Collected Statutes.

sentences.zh: 出為直隸通永道，擢江西巡撫，遷左都御史，仍署巡撫事。

translations.literal: He went out as intendant of the Tongyong Circuit in Zhili, was promoted to governor of Jiangxi, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief, and still acted in governorship affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as intendant of the Tongyong Circuit in Zhili, promoted to governor of Jiangxi, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief, and continued to handle governorship affairs in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一年，召授工部尚書，調刑部，署直隸​​總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was summoned and appointed minister of the Board of Works, transferred to the Board of Punishments, and acted as governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was summoned, appointed minister of the Board of Works, transferred to the Board of Punishments, and served as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以治宗室敏學獄瞻徇，降編修，效力文穎館。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, for partiality in handling the case of the imperial clansman Minxue, he was demoted to compiler and ordered to serve at the Wenyin Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, for showing partiality in the case of the imperial clansman Minxue, he was demoted to compiler and ordered to serve at the Wenyin Hall.

sentences.zh: 遷司經局洗馬，晉秩三品卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to palace lecturer in the Directorate of Education and promoted to third-rank court official.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to palace lecturer in the Directorate of Education and promoted to a third-rank court post.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourteenth year.

sentences.zh: 論曰：方教匪之初起也，苗疆軍事未蕆，楚、蜀空虛，草澤麼《麻骨》，燎原莫制。

translations.literal: The commentary says: When the sect rebels first rose, the Miao frontier campaign was not yet concluded, Huguang and Sichuan were empty, and grassland trifles were like hemp stalks—once the prairie caught fire it could not be controlled.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: When the sect rebels first broke out, the Miao frontier war was still unfinished, Huguang and Sichuan were undefended, and petty troubles in the countryside were like dry hemp—once the steppe caught fire, nothing could contain it.

sentences.zh: 永保、惠齡號曰總統，局於襄陽一隅。

translations.literal: Yong Bao and Huiling were called commanders-in-chief yet were confined to the corner of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao and Huiling were styled commanders-in-chief, yet their operations were confined to the Xiangyang region alone.

sentences.zh: 景安，秦承恩不諳軍旅，賊遂蹈瑕，蔓延豫、陝。

translations.literal: Jing'an and Qin Chen'en were unversed in military affairs; the rebels therefore exploited weaknesses and spread through Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an and Qin Chen'en knew nothing of warfare; the rebels exploited every weakness and spread through Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 宜綿受事，僅顧蜀疆，及勁兵移陝，束手求退矣。

translations.literal: Yi Mian took charge but cared only for the Sichuan frontier; when crack troops were shifted to Shaanxi he could only fold his hands and seek withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian took command but looked only to Sichuan; once the best troops were shifted to Shaanxi, he could do nothing but ask to be relieved.

sentences.zh: 英善、福寧並皆庸材，三年之中，防剿無要領，如治絲而益紛。

translations.literal: Yingshan and Funing were both mediocre talents; within three years their defense and suppression lacked any guiding principle, like untangling silk only to tangle it further.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan and Funing were both mediocre men; for three years their defense and suppression lacked any coherent strategy, like trying to untangle silk and only making the knot worse.

sentences.zh: 仁宗親政，赫然震怒，諸臣相繼罷譴，士氣一新，事機乃轉。

translations.literal: When the Jiaqing Emperor personally took power he was manifestly enraged; the officials were dismissed and punished in succession, morale was renewed, and the situation turned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiaqing Emperor took personal control of the government, his wrath was unmistakable; one official after another was dismissed or punished, morale revived, and the tide of the war turned.

sentences.zh: 廟堂戰勝，固有其本哉！

translations.literal: Victory at court indeed has its foundation!
translations.idiomatic: Victory at court indeed rests on its foundations!
